He made an ice statue of Dr. Julien to honor him but was interrupted by General Cryptor with Nindroids, who destroyed the statue. Zane then started to fight the Nindroid ghosts. The Nindroids proved easy to defeat, but Cryptor started to take the upper hand by copying Zane as they fought. However, Zane defeated him by causing him to accidentally hit himself with his Departed Blades and the spirit of Cryptor faded away.

Zane then returned to the Museum, where he met the other ninja (except Cole) telling them what occurred to him and learns they went through similar events. The gathered ninja wondered what brought the ghosts back as Master Wu arrived telling them it was Yang's plan of distracting them as Morro arrives confirming this. Seeing Morro, the ninja prepare for battle but Wu stops them by stating Morro's intentions turned out to be good. Zane and the ninja then learn from Morro of Master Yang's evil plans and how part of it was tricking Cole into opening a rift to return to Ninjago. When Jay wondered how Yang tricked Cole, Zane pointed out Cole wasn't there as the ninja realized that they forgot Cole and Wu told them to head the Destiny's Bounty to travel to the Temple of Airjitzu, where Yang and Cole were located. All but Morro (who returned to the Departed Realm) then headed for the Temple to stop Yang.

When they arrived, there was a huge storm, by the rift, summoned by Yang. Yang's students and Cole, with help of Airjitzu, flew through the rift, which then ended, just as the storm. Zane and the ninja then landed with the Bounty and searched for Cole. When they started to despair, Cole appeared, back in his human form with the ninja celebrating his return. At Cole's suggestion, they made the restored Temple of Airjitzu their new base and celebrated the Day of the Departed by a fireplace.

The Hands of Time

The Hands of Time[]

The Hands of Time[]

The ninja were cleaning up the museum when Nya discovered the painting of her and Kai's parents. After reflecting on their past with their parents, Cole ushered them to check out another painting they found, which was of the battle where the Elemental Masters had fought with Krux and Acronix. Cole asked if anyone recognized the battle, and Zane asked P.I.X.A.L. to analyze it. She explained to them that the battle had taken place 40 years ago during the Serpentine Wars. Then, when Dr. Saunders came in to offer the ninja refreshments, Lloyd asked about the painting. Saunders called it "minor skirmish" and told the ninja that it had no historical significance, which prompted Zane to ask him, "Even if it is a myth, who are these men Masters Wu and Garmadon supposed to be fighting?" Dr. Saunders told them about the Hands of Time, and how they could manipulate time, and their names were: Krux and Acronix.

Following the Fast-Forward Blade's arrival at the Monastery, and time skipping an entire minute, the ninja were sent from running out of the museum to standing at the bridge of the Destiny's Bounty. With alarms going off all around them, the ninja began to wonder how they ended up there. Zane mentioned that his circuits were picking up an energy displacement. Zane and Nya then tried to figure out the location of the energy displacement, while Jay freaked out about the noises in the background. They found out that the energy displacement was temporal energy, and was coming from Wu's Monastery. After remembering that Wu was still there, they decide to check it out.

They arrived and found Acronix fighting with Wu. They intervened, and "defeated" him, but Acronix merely used the Time Blade to warp away. The ninja found Wu holding on to a tree branch about to fall, and help him up.

The Hatching[]

The ninja returned to the Temple of Airjitzu to rest Wu, and asked him questions about who they just fought. Wu told them all about Krux and Acronix, before he fell asleep―which left the ninja having nothing to do anymore. While they were cleaning up the Temple, they saw on the News that a samurai warrior (a Vermillion) was attacking the Borg Store. They raced down there to find out who would fight him first, and when it ended up being a tie, they asked Zane to use his digital dice to decide. Each of them got a chance fighting the Vermillion, but it was too strong for one at a time so they all fought at once. The battle continued into the store, and Zane discovered that the Vermillion was attempting to kidnap Cyrus Borg, so he took him away from the fight and into an alleyway. Borg spots Dr. Saunders, and asked him why he was there before Zane was suddenly struck down.

After dealing with the Vermillion, the ninja found Zane unconscious in the alleyway, alone.

A Time of Traitors[]

After asking Master Wu about the Vermillion, the ninja (except for Kai, who went to the museum to ask Dr. Saunders about the Vermillion) met at the Samurai X Cave to figure out how to reboot Zane. After trying multiple times, with no success, a video of Zane's last moments awake played on the screen. After replaying it, and slowing it down some more, they realized that Acronix was the one that disabled Zane and that Acronix and Saunders were working together. The ninja left Zane in the Samurai X-Cave on a restore and reboot protocol so they could go warn Kai. As they left, P.I.X.A.L. appeared on the screen above Zane and ordered him to wake up and that Kai needed them.

The ninja returned to the X-Cave after discovering that Saunders was actually Krux, and finally rebooted Zane. He woke up without leaving the bench and blurted out the numbers "4721" in that order before falling back asleep.

Scavengers[]

After rebooting Zane's system, Nya thought she succeeded but found he was only speaking gibberish. P.I.X.A.L. attempted to explain to Nya that she was trying to unscramble Zane's neural pathway, unaware that that was causing him to speak nonsense. Nya then left to retrieve a binary power cord, much to P.I.X.A.L.'s dismay.

After a confrontation with the Vermillion, Nya came back to the cave but found Vermillion trying to take Zane's metal. She fended them off, but Zane was unable to fight. P.I.X.A.L. sent the electricity to his chest, shocking the Vermillion, and killing them. Nya took Zane with her back to where the Vermillion were stealing metal from buildings.

The ninja stopped the Vermillion and tried to find a way to get Zane's power back, and they figured out that they could go to the Power Plant. At this time, Lloyd also went there to meet the ninja. When they arrived, they entered to find no Vermillion inside. Zane said something in gibberish, and Nya translated that there are Vermillion all around them. They started to fight them (except for Zane, who was walking into a wall.) and Nya and Jay found the main core and hooked Zane up to it after defeating the Vermillion and do something that caused Zane to reboot, and return to normal. The others filled him in on what's going on and saw on the news that Mega Monster Amusement Park was being invaded by Vermillion. The ninja left to the Park (except Jay, who left to make sure his parents were safe). Before they drove away, Zane asked P.I.X.A.L. something, but she did not respond.

A Line in the Sand[]

Zane and the other ninja were fending off Vermillion in Mega Monster Amusement park, when they were cornered, which prompted them to wonder where Jay was, as he had disappeared.

Jay found his parents in trouble with the Vermillion at their Junkyard when the second Time Blade arrived. The Vermillion took Edna—to go after the blade—and Jay attempted to go after her but his bike was broken. His father gave him his early birthday present which is an early version of the Desert Lightning that broke down when touched, so Jay fixed it up and pursued the Vermillion.

Meanwhile, the ninja chased after the Vermillion who left the Amusement Park. Before they departed, however, Zane began reciting the numbers 34 and 28. The ninja assumed he got knocked offline again, but Nya told them that he was referring to latitude and longitude. Zane recalled that Nya updated her Temporal Scanner, so now he knew the Time Blade's location, which was at the Eastern Sea of Sand. They took off on the Ultra Sonic Raider. The ninja and Zane met Jay, who was chasing the Vermillion while attempting to retrieve the Time Blade before them. In the chase, Zane and Nya were knocked off their Ultra Sonic Raider bike, as well as the other ninja, so then they ran after the Time Blade on foot.

After a quarrel with the Time Blade being possessed by the Vermillion, the ninja finally retrieved it and escaped by slowing down the Vermillion. The ninja then fly away on what was left of the Ultra Sonic Raider Jet, while Zane helped stabilize the wings.

The Attack[]

After returning to the Temple after retrieving the Time-Blade, Cole, Zane, and Jay were relaxing by fooling around with the blade. Cole accidentally almost hit Nya in the head with the Blade, and she demanded them to cut it out. The three boys mentioned how she had been trying to locate her Samurai X suit since it was apparently stolen by the Vermillion, and also how Kai had been reading through many history books to, unbeknownst to them, figure out where he had seen the symbol under the Vermillion's helmet before. Kai mumbled something about finding a clue, and the others returned to playing with the Time Blade. Cole and Jay proceeded to run at each other, while Zane slowed them down.

Lloyd then entered in the middle of this and reminded them that they should have hidden it. Cole poked fun of Lloyd, and Wu appeared saying the same thing word for word, adding that they should not let victory cloud their vigilance. As he finished talking and began walking away, a Vermillion egg crashed through the window. The ninja discovered that outside, the Vermillion were all lined up and ready to attack. They got into a battle with the Vermillion, and one Buffmillion. The Vermillion still attacked, so Lloyd tried to defeat the Vermillion on the ground. During this time, the Destiny's Bounty was attacked, and it crashed to the ground. The Time Twins later intervened and battled against the ninja, and Wu and the ninja ended up taking the Fast-Forward Blade. At this time, the Samurai X Mech stepped in to help. Nya assuming that the Vermillion stole her suit, but it turned out that the new Samurai X was no Vermillion, however, they refused to reveal their identity. Samurai-X retreated but was knocked out of the sky by an egg. Now, the ninja continued to fight the Time Twins, and they believed they had won, but General Machia swooped in from the air and steals both Time Blades, and returned it back to the twins. Before they could escape, Machia captured Wu.

Secrets Discovered[]

At the Temple, Lloyd was giving a pep talk to the ninja about how even though they lost, it can be good thing that they took the time blade because then they can follow the Hands of Time back to their base. The ninja split up and Kai and Nya go to Destiny's Bounty to see if the Temporal Scanner works. Cole and Jay go with Lloyd and Zane who take Destiny's Shadow to the museum to find any clues. While on the Shadow, Zane asks P.I.X.A.L. a question but then remembers that she is still "offline". Zane, Jay, Cole, and Lloyd search the museum for anything, all the while, Jay is throwing artifacts all over, which leads Zane to tell him to stop, as he catches everything he throws. Lloyd comments on how he's glad Zane is fully functional, and he agrees, except for the fact that he can no longer talk which P.I.X.A.L. which angers him. Then, Cole accidentally punches a hole in the wall which leads to a secret room off of the museum. They enter, and find Vermillion eggs incubating in a tank. Off of the secret room is another secret door that leads to the sewers. They enter the sewers and Zane reconfigures the Destiny's Shadow to float on water. It picks them up, and they use it to navigate the sewers. Along the way, they meet Skales and his son who tells them that they're tracking the Vermillion in hopes to avoid them. They tell the ninja that they're the spawn of the Great Devourer and that they are very powerful if they are a horde. He also tells them that their base is in the swamp, and gives them a map that lead there. They reach the swamp and call the rest of the ninja to meet them there.

Pause and Effect[]

When Kai and Nya arrive at the swamp, they make a plan to rescue Master Wu, and Cyrus Borg. They split up, Zane is to use his scanner to find Borg. Zane locates Cyrus Borg and moves toward him. Moments later, the signal disappears, which causes Zane to fall to his knees and sulk about how P.I.X.A.L. is gone and that it's "no good". After sulking for a few minutes, Zane's scanners pick up Borg's signal once again. He runs towards it and meets Lloyd halfway. Lloyd tells him that he found Wu, but lost him again. Zane consoles him and then picks up Jay and Cole's signal. Lloyd and Zane hear them yell, and meet them battling the Vermillion, so they help out. They appear to finish them off and see the Time Twins in the air wit Wu, Ray, Mia, Kai, and Nya. They begin to Airjitzu after them, but Blunck and Raggmunk ambush them with more Vermillion.

Out of the Fire and Into the Boiling Sea[]

Zane, Cole, Jay, and Lloyd make a "strategic retreat" because they can't handle all the Vermillion. Zane covers them with Ice so they can escape, but he picks up Borg's signal again and he says he's going to get him. The others join him in avoiding the warriors and escaping. When the Vermillion realize that the ninja have gone, they all go back to their main base which is unfortunate for the ninja because they need to go there too. Lloyd suggests they disguise themselves as Vermillion in order to enter, and it works. At the entrance of the dome, they meet Cyrus Borg and they get him to escape. First, Jay asks why the Twins kidnapped him in the first place. He reveals that they were making him create the hub for the Iron Doom, that would be used for time travel. He tells them that with all four time-blades, it will be active. Borg tells them that he put in a self-destruct code so that they could stop it, but he did not have the time to enter it in so they had to do it now. Borg tells them that they have to sneak in (to the dismay of Jay). Just then, Blunk and Raggmunk enter and order the disguised ninja to escort Borg away from the Iron Doom, but Jay breaks character which causes their identities to be revealed. They get into a battle with the Vermillion once again, and this time, the new Samurai X shows up with new armor and starts to help them. They battle, and Borg tells Sam-X that he needs to get to the Iron Doom, so they bring him to the top to input the code. Zane uses Airjitzu to fly up with them, and helps Borg remember the code, which is the first line of code for programming a Nindroid. They are about to finish the code when the Time Twins return with all four Time Blades. They use the pause blade to stop Zane from finishing the code and order the warriors to enter the Iron Doom. They place the Time Blades into the Iron Doom and push Zane, Borg, and Sam-X off the platform. Zane falls and Cole catches him. They watch now, as Kai and Nya use the Fusion Dragon to enter the same portal the Time Twins do.

Lost in Time[]

The ninja sulk about how Nya and Kai had just traveled back in time, and are introduced to Ray and Maya who tells them that the only way to help Master Wu (as he had been hit with a Time Punch, that causes him to rapidly age) is to get the Reversal Blade back. During this time, Jay tries to figure out Samurai X's identity, but they refuse once again.

Once Krux and Acronix had gone back in time to change Ninjago, their machination of the past altered the future so that there was no more technology. This act caused Zane's form to change back human in present-day and he is shown shut down, since he doesn't have power source in this timeline.

After Kai and Nya stopped the Time Twins, and Wu sacrificed himself on the Iron Doom, the siblings return to present-day Ninjago, where Zane has returned back to titanium and questions what occurred.

The ninja then nominate Lloyd as their master. Zane listened as Lloyd made his first decision to get rid of the Time Blade and find Master Wu.

Way of the Departed

Way of the Departed[]

This section is a stub. You can help expand this section by adding some information.
Prior to Sons of Garmadon

Prior to Sons of Garmadon[]

At some point over the course of the next year, Zane gained new abilities.[5]

One week before the team was reassembled, Zane, having been alerted by the Police Commissioner of a new criminal group making recruits, contacted Kai and planned to investigate Borg Industries and search online for further information.[6]

Sons of Garmadon

Sons of Garmadon[]

The Mask of Deception[]

It is revealed by P.I.X.A.L. that the Ninja, besides Lloyd, are on "active missions throughout Ninjago" while he chases Mr. E.

The last to be seen, Kai and Zane are stationed in a port town, similar in features to Stiix, fighting the Mechanic, who now wears a ripped red jacket instead of his prison uniform. P.I.X.A.L. tells Zane—who is now in his human form but with blue eyes. Through an earpiece that Master Lloyd requires his and Kai's assistance in Ninjago City, with which he replies "this is serious" while watching Kai fend off the Mechanic. He tells P.I.X.A.L. that they'll be with them shortly, and hangs up to use his ice power and freezes the Mechanic before he could attack Kai. He lifts his hood, revealing his new hair, and his brand new cloaking ability that lets him transform between titanium and human whenever he wants. He tells Kai they should move but sees he froze him as well.

Zane and Kai meet up with Lloyd and the others at Borg Tower, where the Mask of Vengeance was stolen. Lloyd shows them why he brought them there and pulls up a picture of the Sons of Garmadon's symbol on his phone to show everyone. He begins to tell them what it is before Zane interrupts him to say "The Sons of Garmadon. A mysterious criminal syndicate growing in prominence in Ninjago City." Lloyd tells them what they stole before Hutchins comes in and tells them about the Oni Masks, and how there are only three in existence. Jay gets confused and asks how there can be three when they stole the "only" mask. Nya corrects him and tells him that he said Oni Mask, which prompts Zane to say, "The Oni are said to be all-powerful beings; demons that predate Ninjago." Hutchins tells them that the three masks embody the main Oni Warlords and has unknown consequences when united.

Hutchins tells them that the Emperor is going to give a public speech tomorrow, and he is worried that the SoG might show up, so he asks for their help in protecting them.

At the palace, Zane is perched on the top of a building with his bow and arrow, and points that Lloyd seems to like Harumi. He then seems to spot something suspicious, and the crowd clears out, but it was a false alarm.

Zane and the others are invited into the "Palace of Secrets" as a reward for protecting the Royal Family. When they reach the throne room, Hutchins introduces the Emperor and Empress as well as Harumi. Harumi does a sort of "roll call" where she runs through the Ninjas' names and powers. She describes Zane as "The cold and calculated android" which prompts Zane to drop his human disguise and correct her by saying, "I'm a Nindroid, your highness."

The Royal Family invites the ninja to stay at the palace until the threat of the SoG is gone and so Hutchins takes the ninja on a tour of the Palace. He shows them the buffet, and Cole mentions how he's watching his diet, and Jay refers to him as a "party pooper," which Zane does not understand.

Hutchins tells them that the Oni Mask they hold in the Palace in the Mask of Deception, while the Mask of Vengeance was the one stolen from Borg. When asked who has the third mask, Zane says "No one knows the location of the Mask of Hatred but my senses tell me that it will not stay lost for long."

After the tour ends, Zane asks Cole what a party pooper is, and when he tells him, Zane does not entirely understand and says "It is nice to have a pooper at the party!"

The Jade Princess[]

The day after Lloyd returns from talking with Harumi, Zane and the ninja are training in the Palace Courtyard. The ninja are remarking that Lloyd technically went on a "date" with Harumi, to which Lloyd replies that it was not a date. Zane, while training with Kai, gives Lloyd the definition of a date. He also gives Lloyd the definition of "step up your game."

Later, when the Palace is attacked, Zane uses his visor to find Harumi who was stuck under a piece of wood. He helps her out and tells her that they need to get out of there. On their way out, Zane uses Inverted Spinjitzu (upside down) to save Hutchins from Ultra Violet, causing her to become frozen.

Zane manages to escape the Palace with the other ninja before it collapses and meets Lloyd and Harumi on the Destiny's Bounty. Nya breaks the news to Harumi that the Emperor, Empress, and Hutchins didn't make it, and Harumi remarks on how she's all alone. Lloyd promises her that they're going to find the people responsible for this, and they fly off on the DB.

The Oni and the Dragon[]

Zane and the other ninja are sailing on the Bounty when Harumi thanks the ninja for taking her in. Jay tells her that she's safe with them, to which Zane corrects him by saying that they know little about the SoG. He also notes that the third Oni Mask is yet to be located and that it's as if it "never existed." Nya tells them that the police have one of the SoG in custody and that they should question him.

On their way to the station, Jay, Cole, Zane, and Lloyd take a quick stop at Mystake's Tea Shop to get a tea that would make the suspect talk. Mistake goes to the back to grab the tea, and on her way back in, Lloyd spots a strange painting on the wall. She tells him that it's of the Oni and the Dragon. Lloyd wants to hear more, but Zane says they only have time for a quick stop. Lloyd tells Cole and Zane to go to the station with the tea of truth to meet the suspect while he and Jay stay to listen to the story.

At the station, Zane hands Cole two cups, one of the tea of truth, and the other for Cole to drink. When a prisoner breaks loose and causes havoc, it causes Cole to mix up which drink is which.

They enter the interrogation room and meet the SoG member in the white mask: Luke Cunningham. Zane demands him to tell him who he works for, but Luke doesn't tell him. Cole tries to give him the tea to make him talk, but he mixed them up and drinks the tea himself and starts telling Luke his secrets including where the Princess is and what kind of power Lloyd has. This reveal of all the secrets causes Luke to mistakenly tell them about their hideout, at Laughy's Karaoke Club. Zane takes note of this and they leave with the lead.

Zane and Cole watch as Ultra Violet and Mr. E arrive at the club. Cole gets ready to go in, in a disguise called "Rocky Dangerbuff." He offers to make Zane a costume of his own, but Zane declines and creates a disguise with his hologram ability. Cole dubs him "Snake Jaguar."

They proceed into the club and notice that Dareth is running the bar. He tells them that he bought the bar so that he'd be able to hold on to the "glory days" where he fought "side by side" with the ninja, but the SoG made it their hangout spot. Cole asks Zane how they're supposed to gain their trust, and Zane tells him that there's only one way—and that's for Cole to sing (which he is afraid of).

Cole gets up to the mic and starts singing terribly. The bikers get angry and start to kick him out. Cole fights back and asks for Zane's help but he only helps the SoG. . . .

At the Bounty, the other ninja are watching and P.I.X.A.L. tells them to trust Zane. They head over to the club to help Cole and start chasing Mr. E. They chase him up to a dead-end where he climbs up a clothesline wearing the Mask of Vengeance. He fights with the ninja until he gets to the top where he fights with Lloyd for a moment until Lloyd is stopped by Snake Jaguar, who helps Mr. E escape. Lloyd tells the ninja that it was Zane's plan all along to gain their trust. . . .

Mr. E takes Snake Jaguar on his bike with Ultra Violet. She says, "You're taking him to the big man?" before they drive away.

Snake Jaguar[]

The episode begins with a flashback of Wu meeting Dr. Julian in his home. Wu asks him where Zane is, and he is informed that he is out back chopping wood. Julian makes note that Wu has been their second guest in a while, as an old man visited them last night who needed shelter. He also says that when he arrived, it was as if winter had followed him there, to which Wu remarks that it was the Master of Ice. They gave him shelter and food and was intrigued by Zane. Ever since he left, he has been acting stranger than usual. Wu meets with Zane, and Wu tells him that they may meet again one day.

Zane awakes from his flashback on a subway train with the Sons of Garmadon on their way to their base. They take a shortcut through the subway that leads them to a hidden place. As they step off the train, Ultra Violet tells him it's time to meet "the big man."

He enters their hideout and meets Killow (the big man). Zane asks if he is in charge, Killow laughs and says that it is not him that is in charge, but the Quiet One. Killow says that if he wants to be a Son of Garmadon, he has to ride with them at "The Teeth." Ultra Violet remarks that Zane has no bike, so Killow gives him Ultra Violet's for now.

After his meeting with Killow, he uses his cloak feature to sneak past the guards as Ultra Violet to visit Cole, who has been locked in a cell. Cole asks to be broken out because they found the key to the final mask to resurrect Lord Garmadon. Zane doesn't break him out because he has to race now. Zane leaves Cole and gets in line with the other SoG.

They start, and as they ride, Ultra Violet gets a call (presumably from the Quiet One). They tell her that Snake Jaguar (Zane) is a spy, and Killow tells the rest of the racers to make sure Zane never finishes. They ride through the subway until they emerge in Ninjago City, and Nya gives Zane a new bike to combat the SoG's high tech ones. During the race, Zane spots the Mask of Deception on Killow's bike. He tells P.I.X.A.L. that he doesn't know who's in charge, but that he is called the Quiet One.

Zane continues racing into the Sea of Sand and uses some of his new bike's features to knock out more bikers. Killow wears the Mask of Deception and uses it to telepathically throw spikes of rock at Zane to slow him down. Zane uses his new falcon to destroy the rocks and continues racing.

Killow tells Mr. E that it was he that brought him in, so he should deal with him.

Killow rides on, and Mr. E stays behind to deal with Zane. He rides next to him and steers his bike, as well as Zane's, into a nearby cliff. Zane says "You're the Quiet One, aren't you? You're the one in charge? Who are you!" and they jump off the bikes before they fall into the cliff. Zane gets up and sees Mr. E on the ground twitching . . . and he gets up and puts his arm back on, which fell off in the crash. Zane says that Mr. E is like him—a Nindroid. . . .

Dead Man's Squall[]

Picking up where the previous episode left off, Zane has confronted Mr. E at a cliff and has begun asking him multiple times if he is The Quiet One. Mr. E runs at Zane and almost throws him over the cliff. They continue to fight (With Mr. E winning) and Zane attempts to freeze Mr. E solid, but he breaks out. He then kicks a severely damaged Zane off the cliff. He jumps down to him, and Zane goes offline. Mr. E opens a compartment in Zane's chest and places something in it. He then turns around and says "The trap has been set" in reverse, and leaving Zane.

A few hours later, it is dark, and the ninja fly over the desert in the Bounty looking for Zane. They finally spot him submerged in sand and unconscious. They put him on a gurney and bring him up to the ship. He is placed on a table, and P.I.X.A.L. says that it may take a while for Zane to reboot himself. The ninja plan to abandon Ninjago City to get away from the Sons of Garmadon so they can get a handle on things. They find out later that in Zane's last moments of consciousness, he intercepted a call between Mr. E and the Quiet One. P.I.XA.L. says she could track him, but the storm is interfering. Later, while the ninja are gone, a mechanical spider (placed there by Mr. E) comes out of the compartment in Zane's chest and enters the computer, damaging P.I.X.A.L. and the tech. The ninja find out, and P.I.X.A.L. informs them that something is approaching the Bounty. She says that it's Samurai X and that she is her. But Samurai X flies in on her mech (being controlled by the Quiet One) and tries to knock them out of the sky. The ninja leave Zane to fight with the Quiet One, and Nya stays behind to try and find whatever screwed up the computers.

She finds the Mechanical Spider, and it starts to attack her, and it's not until Zane wakes up, that it is defeated. P.I.X.A.L. managed to wake Zane up, and commenced a full system reboot, thus, freeing Samurai X from The Quiet One after he knocked Lloyd and 'Rumi into the jungle. However, he still did massive damage to the Bounty, which causes it to crash. Nya breaks the fall with her elemental power, and they land in the bushes ok.

When they land, Samurai X removes her mask revealing she really is P.I.X.A.L., and Zane says that from now on there will be no more secrets between them.

The Quiet One[]

Zane and the ninja work on the Bounty after it crashed in Primeval's Eye. Zane and P.I.X.A.L. search for Lloyd and Harumi through the jungle, but they are unable to find him. P.I.X.A.L. suggests that they get the computers running again, and they go to the bridge.

At the bridge, they figure out that they won't be able to find Lloyd and Harumi unless they fly over the trees. They test the thrusters, but it only makes things worse so they turn it off.

Nya enters with the Samurai X mech and shows the others that Lloyd wrote them a note telling them that they're going to find the Oni Temple for the third mask.

Zane and P.I.X.A.L. return to fixing up the computer, and after many unsuccessful attempts at turning it on, Zane detects frustration in P.I.X.A.L.'s voice and asks if she's alright. She asks if she is more useful in the computer, and says she prefers having a body, but also just wants to be useful to the team. Zane says that it is her choice and that he also prefers her body rather than in the computer, and they continue working.

After trying to fix the computers, Jay and Cole are working on the thrusters when the baby (dubbed Cole Jr. by Cole) hands Jay a wrench. The other ninja meet up with Jay and see that the baby is now walking, talking, and drinking tea. Jay realizes that the baby isn't Cole Jr., but Master Wu.

They wonder how he got so young, and Nya points out that he was touched by the Reversal Blade, and that it not only fixed his rapid aging, but he is now rapidly de-aging. Zane points out that by that logic, he should be rapidly aging again until he returns to normal. They are interrupted by the Sons of Garmadon's attack, and the ninja scramble to get the Bounty in the air.

They try to get the Bounty flying before they find out that the trace program they ran to find the location of The Quiet One has finally finished. They find out that the transmission came from the Bounty. Zane points out that that can't be, as the only people on the ship were them and Harumi, to which Nya states: "Harumi is The Quiet One!"

Zane says they have to warn Lloyd, but they are interrupted by the Sons of Garmadon, who have infiltrated the Bounty. The ninja fight them off best they can, but they are cornered by the S.o.G. and Mr. E, and Killow putting on the Mask of Vengeance, and Mask of Deception.

Game of Masks[]

The Ninja, now taken captive by the Sons of Garmadon on the Bounty, are tied up in the middle of the S.o.G. flying the ship looking for Harumi and the Oni Temple. Killow says he looks forward to Garmadon's resurrection, to which Zane remarks that usually when a bad guy tries to unleash an ancient evil, it usually doesn't end well for them. Ultra Violet says "Good thing then that this bad guy is actually a bad girl."

Later, Little Wu gives Nya the keys to unlock their chains, and the ninja fight back against the S.o.G. Zane points his bow and arrow at Mr. E and they have a standoff before the Sea Monster crashes the fight and starts hurting both sides. The ninja and the S.o.G. work together to weaken it before Harumi (who now is known by everyone to be The Quiet One) and the biker gang escape on the Bounty with all three masks.

Before they escape, Zane and Nya help Lloyd up into the air so he can stop them . . . but Lloyd is captured when he lands.

Dread on Arrival[]

Zane and the ninja (along with Baby Wu, and P.I.X.A.L.) arrive at the Ninjago City Police Station on the Sea Monster. One of the guards is confused as to why they brought the Sea Monster, and Zane says "The best way to defeat your enemy, is to make them your friend."

They arrive at the Police Commissioner's office and start bombarding him with saying that they have to vacate the city and stop the Sons of Garmadon, and he calls in the police force to help them out.

Later, at night, the ninja are watching the Palace, where the S.o.G. have taken their base. They begin "Operation Undercover." The police arrive at the palace, making a distraction to the S.o.G. so the ninja can sneak in.

Zane and the others get on snorkel gear, and hop on Kai's Katana V11 and ride under the Palace moat. They arrive at the Resurrection Ceremony, where Harumi (now wearing her Quiet One outfit) has already opened the portal to the Departed Realm. They also see that they have Lloyd and Misako captive. They interrupt the ceremony and start attacking the Sons of Garmadon. Harumi reveals that they can plunge Lloyd or his mother underwater, and they are forced to save one of them. Zane tries shooting Harumi with his arrow, but he is intercepted by Mr. E. He continues to fight Zane when he is knocked to the edge after dropping his sword, and Zane pointing an arrow at his throat. Cole saves Misako and Lloyd from their cages, and the team tries to stop Harumi from completing the ceremony, but the energy around it is too much for any of them to do it.

Lord Garmadon begins to arrive, and Zane is confused as to how it is happening, to the dismay of Jay. Lloyd tries using Spinjitzu to intercept Harumi, and Zane and the others follow. They knock over Harumi, and the cops enter, arresting Harumi and the Sons of Garmadon.

The ninja see Harumi off, and Lloyd goes to speak to her, and then she is taken away.

True Potential[]

Zane and the team (except for Lloyd) are celebrating at Dareth's bar, singing The Weekend Whip with baby Wu. They are having a good time when Lloyd stops the music and points to the TV, where the news shows that Lord Garmadon is back—and he has broken Harumi out of prison. Misako offers to take Baby Wu somewhere safe so the ninja can investigate, and they head off.

They get to the police station and find that the police officers could not stop them, and the Police Commissioner notes that it seems like the man Garmadon once was, is gone. They try to find their location when the news pipes up again and says that Garmadon and Harumi have broken into Kryptarium Prison.

They board the Bounty, and Zane notes that they could barely beat the S.o.G. with the help of the police force last time, and now they have Lord Garmadon on their side. They try to brainstorm ideas on how to stop them, but the only one they've thought of is for Lloyd to face him alone, which Zane and the others dislike. Zane notes that Lloyd's past may be clouding his judgment.

Soon after, Lloyd tricks everyone into the bedroom and locks the door, and takes the Bounty to the Prison to face his father. A little while later, they break out and find that Lloyd has abandoned the Bounty, and taken his car. They try to track it, but the navigation system was locked, which Zane is unable to hack. They keep trying, but then Lloyd's battle with his father is broadcasted nationwide, and the ninja are forced to watch their leader's defeat.

Big Trouble, Little Ninjago[]

Zane and the ninja are at Mistake's tea shop watching over Lloyd, who is unconscious and hurt from his battle with his father. Mistake gives him a tea that will heal his wounds but may take away all of their powers. Zane says immediately that it is no question—and he'd give up his power for Lloyd. The team comes up with a unanimous decision, and agree to give up their power. They use their power and transfer it through Lloyd, who's eyes flash green before fading back into black.

They wait a few hours and find that they still possess their powers, but Lloyd still hasn't woken up. Mistake is making a special tea "to go" and says "In a time of need, remember to go" and hands Jay a small bag. As she does, the ground shakes, and they find that the citizens of Ninjago City are fleeing from something that is wrecking the city, and Zane notes that only something of great size could cause that much damage. As buildings crash around them, they go to find out what's happening, and Nya stays behind to watch over Lloyd.

The ninja chase the being around the city, with the help of P.I.X.A.L., and they find that Lord Garmadon has created a giant Colossus out of rock that's terrorizing the city. Garmadon tells the police commissioner to kneel before them, and they do. The ninja call attention to themselves and the Colossus attacks them. The ninja fight back, and are unable to put a stop to it, and flee to the Bounty.

A little while later, they find Lloyd fighting Harumi on a moving train while holding baby Wu, and tell him to jump onto the Bounty with them, but he is unable. He tries to make the jump, but Harumi pulls him back, and only baby Wu manages to make it aboard the ship. They try to make it back to Lloyd, to save him from Harumi, but are caught by the Colossus and are crushed by it. Baby Wu tells them they have to go, at first, they do not understand, but Jay realizes that's what Mistake told them when she gave them the bag. Jay opens it and golden stars float all around them. In a few moments, they disappear, just before the Bounty is crushed by the monster.

They wake up later, battle-worn, on a desert beach. Zane notes that Mistake gave them travelers tea, and they aren't in Ninjago anymore. A dragon flies by them and they realize they are back where it all began—the Realm of Oni and Dragons.

Hunted

Hunted[]

Firstbourne[]

Zane, along with the first three Ninja and young Wu, are stranded on an island in the Realm of Oni and Dragon trying to piece together some parts to make a transmission device that goes to Ninjago. They are unsuccessful in their first attempt, to the dismay of the others, except Jay, who "accepts the situation," which the other ninja find extremely weird.

Young Wu says that he is hungry, as Zane asks him if he has any useful guidance he can give them, but he does not. Zane mentions that by the rate that Wu is accelerating aging, they will have their old Master back soon enough.

While Cole and Wu go get food, Zane and the others attempt to retry the transmission device in the dark before Cole and Wu get back. As they do so, Zane and Kai note that Jay has lost his grip on reality. It appears the radio works, as they hear a transmission. When Kai doesn't understand some phrases they use, Zane translates them to him by stating that they are talking about an ambush. Zane is worried when Kai realizes that they are targets and that they're not alone, and are being chased by the island's inhabitants. The three of them run, with Zane being the first to be taken away by the hunters and dragged through the fog.

Held captive, Zane and his friends are brought blindfolded into a settlement known as Dead's End by their captors, the Dragon Hunters. As they are taken inside the throne room, Zane hears Jay wonder aloud if they are playing hide and seek (blindfolded) before being stopped in their footsteps. He also hears Kai attempt to fight back against one of the Hunters escorting them in, but with no success, before the captive trio are shoved to their knees, with Zane warning the pair to be careful. The Hunters then take off their blindfolds for them to meet Iron Baron, who taunts them before he and the Hunters laugh.

Iron & Stone[]

Now brought before the Iron Baron, Zane and the ninja are declared to be Oni, and are to be sent to The Pit to face "Slab."

They are taken outside through Dead's End by Daddy No Legs. They are shown a glimpse of the Dragon Hunter's lifestyle. Kai says that they think they're Oni... and Jay says that they thought it was the other way around. Zane points out that their entire culture appears to be built around the hunting of Dragons, and the exploiting of their Elemental Power. Soon after, Zane is approached by another Dragon Keeper, Arkade, and is asked if he can have his parts after he "expires."

As they continue on their way to the Pit, Jay continuously shows he is not in the right state of mind. Zane points out that Jay's mental state will not be helping them, and that he hopes that Cole and Wu can rescue them.

Later, the three of them are shoved into a room. They assume they're in the Pit, but Chew Toy comes out and reveals that they aren't in the pit yet. Chew Toy signals to the rest of the Dragon Hunters to bring them up and the room they're in heightens into the real pit, which turns out to be an arena where they will be put up against a dragon for entertainment.

Chew Toy warns them about Slab and he is released into the Pit. It is revealed that Slab is a green Dragon that possesses the power of Earth. Chew Toy mentions that they must have upset Slab because Dragons hate Oni.

The ninja are forced to fight Slab, and Jay tries to play with it, using Chew Toy's bell. They are chased throughout the arena, and Zane tells the others to not use their Elemental Power, as not to reveal their true identities. They soon see that Cole and Wu have come for their rescue, Zane tells Cole that Wu has to leave, as his mere presence (being half Oni) is making things worse for them. Wu gets the idea to throw a Vengestone chain to them, which helps the ninja subdue Slab. After it is on the ground, it is about to use it's earth breath to blast Jay, but Zane uses his Elemental Power to block the blast, thus revealing their identities to the Iron Baron and the rest of the Dragon Hunters.

Iron Baron and Heavy Metal yell to the other Dragon Keepers to hunt them down, and the ninja prepare for round 2.

Radio Free Ninjago[]

Zane, Jay, and Kai are cornered by the Dragon Hunters and have no choice but to use their Elemental Power. When Kai does an estimate on the foes, Zane corrects him on the exact number and he states Zane was better at counting. After Jay starts to freak out about things, Zane points out to Kai that he's finally back to normal.

They use their Elemental Power to fend of the Hunters when Heavy Metal jumps down with the Dragonbone Blade. They try to use their power on him, but as Zane points out, the blade attracts their Elemental Power. Now unable to use their power, they are chained up by Heavy Metal and put in the back of the Dieselnaut.

Held in place by the hunters with Vengestone, Iron Baron approaches them and admits his surprise at them not being Oni, but trained in the ways of the First Spinjitzu Master. Zane was shocked by Baron's familiarity with him as the labels calling the Spinjitzu master a coward who ran away to Ninjago. After Kai asks if he knows how to get them back, Baron responds no but states he had no interest in helping them, anyway. He then declares they are hunting Dragons and hopes that the catch he makes will be good.

Iron Baron tells them that there is much the ninja can do for them, and that "power attracts power," which will help them hunt Dragons. He then turns on the machine and it releases strange energy that triggers an elemental reaction in them to use them as bait to catch a Dragon.

Soon after, a Wind Dragon is attracted to the Ninja. Meanwhile, Cole and Wu (who are disguised as Hunters,) "accidentally" knock the other ninja off the stand. They try to rescue them, but the ninja are immediately put back into the back of the Dieselnaut by Daddy No Legs.

Now in the back of the vehicle, they are forced to sit back and watch as the Hunters reel in and eventually capture the Wind Dragon.

Cole promises to figure a way out of this situation for them, and the Dragons.

How to Build a Dragon[]

While being transported back to the Dead's End in the back of the Dieselnaut, Jay hears Lloyd on the radio, which prompts Zane to say Jay has lost it again until Jay states he really did. that they hope Cole can get them out of there. Kai says all, including the Wind Dragon.

Now at Dead's End, Zane says that if only Firstbourne paid Iron Baron a visit, then they would have a distraction to escape. This gives Jay the idea to create a fake Firstbourne to trick Iron Baron into thinking they're under attack. Zane agrees with the idea, and Cole and Wu agree to help them build the plan as long as Jay designs it.

Later on, the ninja are put to work by the Iron Baron, and Jay draws the blueprint for the fake dragon in hidden. While Zane and the others assemble parts and send them off to Cole and Wu, the two of them assemble the Dragon away from the camp.

Soon after, at night, Iron Baron gets ready to cook the Wind Dragon, and Zane and the others wait for Cole and Wu to "attack" the base with their creation. They are tied up, and watch the skies and then finally, with Wu controlling it, the fake dragon appears over the camp, and Zane and the others act like it is the real thing which spooks the Hunters.

While the Hunters scramble to their stations to capture it, Cole maneuvers to the others and frees them from their chains. They make their way out, and at the same time, Wu is shot out of the sky. At first the ninja don't see it, and see the real Firstbourne in the sky and mistake it for Wu. When they realize it's the real thing they freak out and attempt to flee.

Wu stops them and tells them that she is there to protect her Wind Dragon, but the ninja assisted in capturing it. The only way for them to get out would be to save the Wind Dragon.

Zane and the others make their way to the Dragon, who is tied up, and get caught in a fight with the Dragon Hunters. Kai breaks off from the fight and frees the Wind Dragon. It helps the ninja fend off the Hunters, and the ninja also help the other imprisoned Dragons escape.

Zane and the ninja flee the scene, and Iron Baron says they are going hunting again . . . for the Ninja.

The Gilded Path[]

Zane and the others are camped out in the middle of nowhere, and Master Wu wakes up, now in a teenager body. Zane points out that because of his augmented growth cycle, it is normal for a teenager to grow fast. Wu tells them he had a dream that he was fishing with his father and brother. The ninja realize that he may be getting his memories back, and as they press him for more questions, they are ambushed by Heavy Metal.

He asks Wu if it's true that he is the son of the First Spinjitzu Master. He tells him, and Heavy Metal reveals who he really is. He takes off his mask to reveal a woman with black tied back hair. She says that Heavy Metal is the Hunter name Iron Baron gave her, and her real name is Faith.

She asks Wu if he is back to take the Dragon Armor, which the Firstbourne guards. Wu points in a direction and says that's the way the Armor is. Zane and the others are skeptical, but Wu tells them to "have faith."

The ninja and Faith take a Speeder in the direction they are going. As they haul the Speeder, Faith tells them her story, and how Iron Baron didn't want the others to think that their best hunter was a woman. She tells them the legend of the First Spinjitzu Master, and how he and the Firstbourne had a connection, and together they worked to bridge the divide between the Oni and Dragons. He and the Dragon built the Dragon Armor, but then when he realized that it was impossible to end the war, he left the First Realm, and created Ninjago.

After her story, they are apprehended by Muzzle and Daddy No Legs. Faith pretends to be Heavy Metal in front of the other Hunters, and pretends she caught the Ninja. Muzzle realizes that Wu is taller, and so Kai trips the Hunters with a chain. Zane and the others tie them up, and they steal their Speeders. Now heading towards nowhere, Wu tells them to have faith to find the armor, and then, back to Ninjago.

Two Lies, One Truth[]

Zane and the others take a break from flying to rest and fuel up their speeders. Zane watches as Jay and Kai fight over water, and Faith asks him how he's survived with them so long.

They realize that the Hunters are close by, and fly off. The six of them are chased by Jet Jack and her crew, and the ninja destroy a few of the Hunters' speeders. They eventually run into a sleeping Ice Dragon, and wake it up, causing it to get angry and get in on the chase. The ninja fly into a canyon to lose the Dragon, while it takes care of some of the Hunters. Faith shoots the Dragon with her hook, causing it to fall, leaving the ninja all set.

They keep going, and end up at a fence made of Dragon heads on spikes. Faith tells them that past that way is Oni territory. Wu tells them they must go through there to find the Dragon Armor. Faith warns them about the Oni, and asks if Wu is sure the armor is there. Wu is skeptical to say yes, but goes with his gut.

They travel through the Oni land and meet a dead end. They find a statue of an Oni, and a gate beneath it that leads to an Oni stronghold, and it's already opened. They enter the stronghold and find it abandoned and in ruin. Zane points out that no one has lived there for centuries. Faith points out that Iron Baron lied to them and said not to cross the border because of the Oni, but the Oni are nowhere to be found. She is skeptical about Wu saying there's the real Dragon Armor, and he admits he made it up.

While she freaks out, Wu examines the gate they came in through and find out that it's a map to the Armor.

The Weakest Link[]

Faith wakes Zane and the others up in the morning, and she says that there isn't any time for breakfast, and that they will eat when they get the Dragon Armor to return to "Ninyeego", to which Zane corrects her: "It's Ninjago" and remark it's really not that hard to pronounce." Zane thinks that because the Firstbourne is waiting for the return of the First Spinjitzu Master, she should be happy to meet his son. Faith says that might be true, but it might not be. She tells them they must be masters of the chains to survive in this world.

She asks Kai to demonstrate "catching" a rock to practice, and she realizes they all need some help. He says the first person to catch the rock wins.

While the other ninja have a hard time using their chains, Zane gets it on the first try. He asks if he won, and Jay says they thought he was the judge. Wu joins the others in trying to successfully wrap their chain around the rock, and when the others get it except him, he gets frustrated. Kai gives him some confidence, and he returns to the others and wraps the chain around the rock.

A few moments later, they see Stormbringer flying above them, and they attempt to prove themselves by catching their first Dragon. Zane and the others hold her with the chains, and Wu hops on top of her and rides her for a moment before she knocks him off.

Later on, Faith tells them that to get to the Armor, they must get past the mountain in front of them. They hear the other Dragon Hunters behind them, and realize they were being tracked. They fly through the mountains caves while they're chased, and Iron Baron says finds out that Wu is the son of the First Spinjitzu Master. He tells his Hunters to not go after Faith, but Wu instead. They all get through the cave, with some of the Hunter's men being left behind, and the ninja realize there's no way to stop the Hunters unless they take Dieselnaut.

The ninja work together with their new chain wrapping skills, and board the Dieselnaut. They take control, and use their chain riffles to knock out some more of the Hunters. The Hunters grab the Dieselnaut and while trying to defend it Faith is caught by Jet Jack. She lets the ninja get away without her, while unhooking the back end of the machine, getting the Hunters off their trail.

Saving Faith[]

Zane and the others are hiding behind a rock and observe what appears to be Faith buried in the ground with only her head above. Wu says they have to go save her, but Zane points out that it's most likely a trap. Wu convinces them, and they go down there to help her out.

When they get down there, they remove a gag from her mouth and she tells them they shouldn't have come, as it was a trap. Dragon Hunters pop out from all around them, and capture them. They are brought to their camp, and are tied up on stakes. The ninja try to lighten the mood by making a few jokes, and Iron Baron notices. He prompts Faith to reveal Iron Baron's selfishness to his camp, to which he spreads more lies, and uses the Elemental Amplifier to silence his captives.

At that moment, Wu regains his old memories, and Jay points out that he grew a moustache and a goatee.

Zane and the others watch as Master Wu fights with the Hunters, and as he reveals to the Iron Baron that he really is the son of the First Spinjitzu Master. Iron Baron makes a deal with Wu, saying that if he helps him take the Dragon Armor, he would send him and his ninja home (to the dismay of the Ninja.) Wu tells them to have faith, and he walks off with Iron Baron.

Lessons for a Master[]

Zane and the others were still stuck on the wooden stakes. Above them, two vulture-like birds fly above them, and Kai asks if they are Zane's falcon. Zane remarks that his data picks up that they are a group of avian scavengers, that will pick them apart upon their demise. Faith confirms this, and Jay freaks out.

They notice that the other Hunters are arguing down below. While they're distracted, they try to rock their bodies side to side in order to knock the stakes over. Zane remarks that it will not be helpful, but considering they have no other choice, they do it anyway.

The rocking seems to be working, and they cheer. As they do, Jet Jack asks them what they're doing, and she cuts them down. Zane was skeptical of their intentions and was shocked when Kai told them to eat Cole first. However, Jet Jack tells them that the Hunters no longer want to follow Iron Baron because he only wants to have the Armor for himself. They want the ninja to help them find Iron Baron and Wu, and stop them from getting the Armor.

They arrive at a bridge that leads to the armor, and find that it's too late, as the bridge has fallen.

Zane and the others return from the bridge to give the bad news to the other Hunters, and just then, Wu bursts through the mountain riding Firstbourne without chains, and wearing his father's Dragon Armor. The ninja cheer as he lands, and they hug him. He tells them that Iron Baron has been killed, and the Hunters cheer. The ninja remember that they have unfinished business in Ninjago, and Zane asks Wu if the Firstbourne can give them all a ride. Wu says it's up to her, and she roars, which causes four Dragons (each of the Ninjas' elements) to come out of the mountain and in front of them. Zane gains a new Ice Dragon and is amazed by its appearance.

The ninja mount their Dragons, and they take off, following behind Wu. In the air, the Dragon's spin like they did when the ninja first traveled between realms, and a portal to Ninjago opens. They fly through the wormhole, and speed off into the distance, finally returning home.

Green Destiny[]

Zane and the ninja return to Ninjago through a vortex in the sky. They notice that the city has been totally demolished, before they wonder how their friends are. Nya speaks to them through radio and tells them they're okay, but they need some help. Zane locates their transmission, and leads the others to them.

They find Lloyd and Nya being cornered by the Sons of Garmadon, and Zane uses his Ice Dragon's powers to make the Sons of Garmadon scatter. Zane and the others rest their dragon on the ground, and greet the other Ninja. Zane asks where P.I.X.A.L. and Misako are, and Lloyd reveals that they have been locked away in Kryptarium Prison. Lloyd tells them that his power has not returned, and that Mistaké is no longer with them.

Wu tells the stranded ninja to take down the Colossus, and for Lloyd to join him in stopping his father. The ninja mount their Dragons, and help the remaining citizens escape. The ninja confront the Colossus, and attempt to chain him up using the powers they learned from Faith. They realize it's not working, and they are almost out of chain. Kai gets the idea to board the Colossus, and use the chains they already shot to bring it down.

While Zane and the others distract the behemoth, Kai jumps on it and wraps the already used chains around the Colossus even more, and cause it to topple over. They celebrate, but only momentarily, as the Colossus stands up again. Zane remarks that it was weakened, as Wu appears with Firstbourne using his chain gun while the rest of the Resistance returns to help them out. The Colossus falls for the last time, and while Garmadon's power fades, the life within the Colossus fades.

Zane joins the ninja in watching as the Sons of Garmadon are finally arrested, and they find out that Lloyd's power is back, and Garmadon is gone. Zane meets with P.I.X.A.L., and they hug.

Now, the city must rebuild, and the ninja help clear the Royal Palace. As they clean, Wu returns in his Master form once again, and tells them there is trouble again, and he needs their help. They race out of the Palace to find the citizens of Ninjago gathered together, to thank the ninja for what they've done. Live music plays, and the ninja celebrate.

Zane hugs P.I.X.A.L. who smiles at him and they hold hands, officially becoming a couple while the celebration goes on. The fight is over, for now.

Tales from the Monastery of Spinjitzu

Tales from the Monastery of Spinjitzu[]

Master Class[]

Master Wu decided to give the ninja a review in Spinjitzu, teaching them to balance, conquering fear, focus, and teamwork.

During the lesson on conquering one's fear, Zane was the first to step down towards the clouds that Wu was standing on, prompting for the other ninja to follow suit.

During the lesson in teamwork, the ninja were split into two teams for a sparring session, with Zane being partnered alongside Nya and Jay against Kai, Lloyd, and Cole. During their sparring session, all six ninja knocked into one of the monks painting the Monastery's new mural, spilling the painter's bowl of golden paint over Wu and Kai, leading for Wu to conclude the lesson, remarking sarcastically that they were literally golden.

Elemental Rider[]

Zane and Kai made their way to the Monastery's courtyard where they discovered Jay staring at one of the murals, specifically one that depicted their old elemental vehicles. Upon seeing his friend's state of semi-consciousness, Zane suggested that he had either entered a meditative trance or a spontaneous bout of self-hibernation.

After a comment from Kai, Zane revealed that he could play stored data in a visual format with augmented visuals. He then began to replay a memory of the ninja's battle against the Serpentine, albeit with their appearances altered to their present day looks, much to Kai's annoyance. In the visual replay, Kai and Zane patrolled Ninjago City on their elemental bikes, confronting a group of pillaging Venomari soldiers and scouts. During the confrontation, Zane pursued one scout who ran off with the sack of stolen goods, but was forced to break off his pursuit to assist Kai. Using the Shurikens of Ice, Zane froze a Venomari soldier and knocked the frozen snake into several others before resuming his pursuit, only to be ambushed by many more snakes. With Kai's assistance, Zane was able to shake off his attackers and drive off the snakes. After returning the stolen goods, Zane began juggling to entertain the crowd.

At this moment, Kai interrupted the replay, protesting that Zane didn't juggle anything that day. In response, Zane simply smiled and slyly replied that he had upgraded the visual memory with a new feature: selective memory.

March of the Oni

March of the Oni[]

The Darkness Comes[]

Zane, P.I.X.A.L., and Cole are riding the Earth Driller 2.0 on their way to Ninjago Harbor for a special unveiling from the Commissioner. They are ten minutes late due to traffic, and instead of waiting, opt to make it on foot.

Zane and P.I.X.A.L. runoff as Cole trails behind with his foot asleep until they find a man riding a golf cart. The three of them board the cart until they reach the harbor where the Commissioner and a small crowd are waiting patiently.

They arrive on stage, and the Commissioner (along with Cyrus Borg) unveils their gift to the ninja for their years of servitude. Zane hopes the gift is something similar to the Bounty and is delighted to find that it is in fact the Bounty, rebuilt by using the original blueprints. The three ninja are excited about their gift, and Cole points out the absence of the others. Zane tells him that Jay said he had something important to do.

Much later, the three return to the newly rebuilt Monastery of Spinjitzu to find that Firstbourne and Faith have arrived in Ninjago and that a mysterious darkness has consumed the First Realm, turning people into statues when they come in contact with it. The two are both injured, but they will recover. Lloyd reveals that after visiting his father at Kryptarium Prison, he was told something similar, that a darkness would consume Ninjago too... he called them the Bringers of Doom.

Wu is distressed and shows the ninja a book from his father. There is an illustration of a demon above dark clouds, engulfing a city. Wu tells them that it is an Oni, and his father once believed that they would return to Ninjago and take over everything, turning it all into darkness. They realize that they must warn Ninjago City of the impending darkness, and they board the new Bounty.

On the Bounty, they attempt to ride to the City, but Zane finds that someone wired the control lever wrong. Zane fixes it, and they take off. They eventually make it to the City, albeit with some small inconveniences with their new ship, and find that strange dark clouds have been engulfing the whole City.

They arrive just in time to save the Commissioner from the dark clouds and help them escape.

Zane and the other ninja face the dark clouds, and each of them attempts to thwart it with their Elemental Power. The clouds, however, are not affected, and the ninja retreat. Cole is suddenly caught by the clouds, but he is swiftly saved by Lloyd. They go out to save some more people and have a small faction of citizens spared on the Bounty.

The ninja are distressed about their new foe, and Cole tells them that when the darkness touched him, it was the coldest thing he's ever felt. He also reveals that he saw an Oni in the cloud. Lloyd accepts that they are unable to fight the darkness, and reveals that he knows someone else who can.

Lloyd takes the ninja to Lord Garmadon's high-security prison, and they plead to him that he help them, considering the only thing that can defeat an Oni, is another Oni. They are reluctant, but eventually open Garmadon's cell, letting him free.

Into the Breach[]

Zane and the ninja are boarded the Bounty on their way to Ninjago City. Each of them are freaking out over Garmadon being with them, who they freed from prison the previous episode. Lloyd is unsure if he can be trusted, but they have no other choice, since he is the key to defeating the Oni.

While they speak, Garmadon shuts off the engine and the Bounty begins falling to the ground. Zane presses the switch to turn it back on, and they gain control, only to show how devious Garmadon is. Zane suggests that Lloyd accompany Garmadon during his stay there to prevent any future mishaps.

Later on, Zane calls all the ninja to the bridge for an announcement from Garmadon. He tells them that the only way to stop the Oni from invading, they must destroy the portal from their world to theirs, the Realm Crystal. Since Garmadon is quarter oni, he is to go down there himself. Lloyd also volunteers, being able to survive the dark clouds, since he is an eighth Oni. To venture into the void, Garmadon requires a weapon, to which Zane and the others are reluctant to give him.

They arrive in Ninjago City, and Lloyd and his father get ready to depart. Cole hands the Dark Lord a sword, and he is immediately attacked. Garmadon initiates a brief brawl, only to regain his powers, then he departs into the darkness, and Lloyd is quick to follow suit.

Zane and the others group around the monitor in the bridge to watch Lloyd's endeavor through his head-cam. They watch as Lloyd lands in Ninjago City, and just barely survives from the clouds. As they continue to watch, Lloyd sees the true power of the dark clouds, which is turning all of the citizens to stone. Lloyd is quick to stumble upon Cyrus Borg, who was also frozen. P.I.X.A.L., while watching the feed, is distraught to see her father's fate, and Garmadon reveals that he is in fact alive, but the only way to help him is to destroy the Realm Crystal.

Moments later, Zane receives a distress signal from the City, which he triangulates to a radio station at the edge of the City. Zane and the ninja volunteer to go check it out, to see if there are any survivors, while P.I.X.A.L. stays behind on her Mech to watch out for Lloyd's return.

Meanwhile, they watch as Lloyd and Garmadon encounter two Oni, who they fight and only barely defeat, so they can enter Borg's Tower and find the Crystal. They do so, and find the Realm Crystal has been spewing black smoke, and has turned pitch black. Garmadon tries to destroy it, when his blade is stopped by The Omega's Staff who flings him backwards. Lloyd also tries to attack, but it easily defeated and damages the camera the ninja were using to watch what was happening.

a large Oni with a staff similar to Borg's Tower.

Garmadon attempts to fight it, but the Oni is far too powerful, and he and Lloyd are knocked aside, which cuts off their feed to the other Ninja.

The Fall[]

Zane and the others make their way to the distress call at the NGTV News Station.

They arrive, and take in the survivors, including Gayle Gossip, from the roof. As Jay and Cole are boarding the citizens onto the Bounty, the black clouds close in, and the two ninja are quick to climb back up the latter.

Nya presses the ignition switch, which she forgets is labelled backwards, and an engine blasts Cole off his ladder, and he falls into the clouds. Zane and the others watch as he is submerged in the blackness, and is lost to the darkness. Zane consoles Kai, as they all mourn his loss.

They are forced to fly away as the clouds close in, when Nya gets a message from P.I.X.A.L. saying that she has Lloyd and Garmadon, and need to be picked up due to her running out of fuel. They are saved in the nick of time, and Zane hugs P.I.X.A.L.

Zane and the others break the news of Cole's demise to Lloyd. Garmadon attempts to get them back on track, but they get mad at him for not understanding their loss. Garmadon appeals to Zane, who he assumes is the only one thinking logically, but Zane remarks that he is incapable of logical thought at this time. Garmadon walks away, holding the Armor of the Golden Master.

Endings[]

Zane and the ninja arrive back at the Monastery of Spinjitzu, and break the news of Cole's supposed demise to Master Wu and Misako. The ninja are at a loss of hope, when Garmadon reveals the Golden Master's Armor, and Nya reveals that their plan is to reforge the Golden Weapons of Spinjitzu from the armor, in order to defeat the Oni once and for all.

Kai takes it to the forge, and successfully remakes the Golden Weapons. Zane shows off his new Shurikens of Ice, when the Darkness arrives. Omega and his army marches up the steps of the mountain, and the ninja prepare to fight back.

Equipped with their newly forged weapons, Zane and the others fight back as best they can. Zane freezes several Oni and sends them flying over the edge, when all of a sudden, Cole's Earth Driller comes from the ground, and Cole reveals himself to have survived his fall. Together the Ninja, as well as Garmadon, fight back but it is not enough. They are eventually forced to pull back and take cover in the walls of the Monastery.

The ninja say their goodbyes to each other, as this appears to be their end, when Jay asks Nya to be his Yang. She accepts, and the ninja prepare for their end.

It is at this time that Lloyd notices the Ninjago history mural, and the Tornado of Creation. They decide that the only way to destroy the Oni is with the power of creation. Everyone, including Wu, Garmadon, Lloyd, and Nya join in on the tornado, and the Oni are pushed back.

Everything goes white, and the ninja wake up. The darkness has been destroyed, and the Oni are gone. As the light fades from the Golden Weapons, the ninja rejoice as they have survived.

They realize that Lloyd is missing, and Zane points out that he is laying motionless underneath a pile of wood. He does not wake up, and Wu says that there is no helping him. Suddenly, Lloyd wakes up, and the ninja celebrate.

A little while later, the ninja and their friends celebrate the Oni's defeat, and Zane and the other five ninja paint one last mural on the monastery wall.

Secrets of the Forbidden Spinjitzu

Secrets of the Forbidden Spinjitzu[]

Wasted True Potential[]

Zane is asleep in the Monastery of Spinjitzu when he wakes up to a rumbling sound coming from outside. He goes to investigate and finds the Monastery wall door shaking and glowing. The door suddenly opens, and Aspheera, holding a staff, appears and attacks Zane. She says that she wants revenge.

Zane suddenly has several visions. He sees another, larger serpentine wreaking havoc in Ninjago City and sees a frozen palace. He sees a vision of a man with familiar glowing eyes and clad in samurai armor sitting on a throne, and then a legion of Pyro Vipers marching through Ninjago City terrorizing the people. He then sees an Ice Dragon freeze over a small village, freezing several people solid, including the other Ninja. Jay calls out to him to tell him that Cole has almost beaten his high score in Lava Zombies.

Zane wakes up again to find that it was all, other than the part about Cole beating his high scores, a dream. Zane tells Jay about the dream, and how it was surely a vision. He also other times his visions occurred before Jay tells him not to worry about it, and to watch Cole with the others.

He joins the others as they play a game on the TV. The ninja are engrossed in this game, and Cole eventually beats Zane’s score, which Zane congratulates him for. They get the idea to go hang out in the hot tub, so they do. Kai uses his fire to make it hotter, and the ninja relax. Master Wu barges in and tells them that they are slacking and have forgotten what it means to be Ninja, reminding them that it had been months since they'd defeated the Oni. He takes them out of the hot tub and tells them that they’ve gotten weak. Inside the Monastery, he tells them that long ago, the monks in the Monastery built high walls to keep out beasts, but failed. To defend from the beasts, these monks became Ninja. Wu tells them that if they can survive in a room with the beast for five minutes, they can prove themselves. The ninja end up getting the beast into a box, but Master Wu tells them that he will be training them more.

Throughout the day, each ninja would find booby-traps all around the Monastery, leaving them all exhausted. Eventually, they would meet Master Wu outside, and he challenges them to a fight. If they could defeat him, they'd prove that he was wrong.

Each ninja attacks Wu, but none of them are strong enough to defeat him. Even their elemental powers had weakened at that point. Zane and the others are knocked into a pile, and Wu says that they have all failed, before siccing the lightning chicken at them.

Questing for Quests[]

Zane and the others are in the Monastery courtyard, trying to think of a way to get back in action. They try to take a dip in the hot tub to see if that will help them think while debating what villains they could go after to pass the time. They find that all of the villains still around haven't been causing any trouble, so they decide to go to the Commissioner to see if he has any jobs for them.

They meet with the Commissioner, and he tells them that Ninjago City has had nothing but peace for a long time. An officer eventually comes in and gives them several jobs to do around Ninjago City, but all of them are busts. They try to save a bank robbery, but it's staged for a TV show, they try to break up a fight at the prison, but it was already resolved. After wasting the day looking for things to do, and ultimately failing, they return home and put on the TV.

Gayle Gossip comes on with breaking news. In the Desert of Doom, she meets with Clutch Powers. He tells the TV that he has dug up a mysterious pyramid within the Desert and would need the help of the ninja to explore it. The ninja quickly run off to the Desert to investigate. The TV shows an ancient plate that appears to have the Serpentine from Zane's dream on it.

A Rocky Start[]

The ninja are scrambling around the Monastery trying to get ready to go investigate the Desert of Doom.

Once they’re all packed, P.I.X.A.L. shows them to the hangar bay, where she has made several new vehicles for the Ninja, including the Land Bounty. Zane, Jay, Nya, and Lloyd board the Land Bounty, while Kai and Cole take their own vehicles to the Desert.

When they finally arrive, they set up a camp around an oasis they have found. Zane reads a book about the Desert, telling them that long ago, an ancient tribe once lived in the Desert. They worshipped a thousand-year-old giant scarab beetle called Beohernie. One day, the beetle went out of control, and destroyed the civilization, seemingly for no reason. The beetle suddenly appears and attacks, and the ninja make a run for it to the Bounty.

As the beetle chases them, Cole is knocked over and is almost left behind. He recuperates himself, and the ninja are continued to be chased by the giant.

While making a run for it, a major component to the Land Bounty is devoured by the Beetle, and the ninja are left stranded on a plateau, surrounded by two more scarab beetles.

The Belly of the Beast[]

Zane attempts to repair the Land Bounty, but it will be impossible to escape without the component the beetle ate.

That night, Zane says that the Bounty is useless without the component, and the only way to retrieve it is to go to the belly of the beast itself. He then gets the idea that one of them has to be strapped to a rope and sent into the stomach of the beetle. They play a rock-paper-clamp tournament in order to decide who goes in, and Zane ends up being the winner.

The next morning, they hook up a wire to Cole's Dirt Bike and tie it to Zane. Once Zane is inside, he suddenly has another set of visions. He sees an enormous snake made of fire emerges from a pyramid in the Desert, and sees the female snake from his previous dream attacking him in the Underground base. His visions continue, and he sees himself hurt in a world made of ice and snow.

He then awakens in the stomach of the beetle and finds the component. The ninja get him out quickly, and they reattach the mechanism to the Bounty, and head off, finally escaping from the three beetles.

Boobytraps and How to Survive Them[]

Zane and the others meet up with Clutch Powers in his camp in the Desert of Doom. Clutch refuses to enter the temple. The ninja tries to convince him, but he is unwilling. Zane points out that his book, Boobytraps and How to Survive Them, is key in helping explorers enter ancient tombs and whatnot. Clutch suddenly gets a call from the Explorer's Club, saying that since he hasn't explored in over ten years, his membership will be redacted. In order to preserve his place in the Club, he tells him that he will now be exploring the ancient pyramid.

Clutch and the others enter the Pyramid and find that it is filled with booby traps and ancient markings. He tells them that his book is key in surviving. Their first obstacle is a rickety old wooden bridge. Zane and the others stumble across, but they survive without trouble. Clutch tells them they got lucky, but luck runs out.

As they continue through, they trip over a trap that sends them all sliding down a corridor to a pit of spikes. Kai blasts the spikes with his fire, securing their lives. At the bottom of the pit, they find a dead explorer called Hageman, who failed to read Clutch's book about cobweb traps before heading down a pathway to the next room.

Finally, they find the main chamber, where several sarcophagi are lined out. In the next room, they find a large puzzle on the wall, and Zane points out that when solved, might lead them to a treasure behind the door.

While Jay and Nya attempt to solve it, Zane inspects the ancient markings on the walls. He translates the writing, which is a warning to those attempting to enter the tomb. It tells the story of a serpent whose anger almost destroyed Ninjago until a foolish boy locked her away. He suddenly has a vision of his dream with Aspheera and warns the others not to open the door. He is too late, and the sorceress is awakened. She asks the ninja where the "Treacherous Deceiver" was hiding. The ninja doesn't know who she is talking about and Zane and the others attempt to fight her with Spinjitzu, but she knows the art, and they are unable to stop her.

She takes an interest in Kai, calling him a Fire Elemental, and tells him that for thousands of years she has been locked up, cold and alone. She starts to steal his power from him, and the others are no match for her, and she successfully steals his powers and becomes empowered by fire.

Clutch runs away as the ninja are tied up in chains by Aspheera. She escapes the pyramid and unleashes her army of Pyro Vipers onto Ninjago City.

Ninja vs Lava[]

The ninja are tied up in the ancient pyramid, as lava erupts from within it. The temple begins to collapse upon itself, as Jay attempts to calm himself with Clutch Power's book. They are under the impression that Clutch has abandoned them.

Zane inspects Kai, who has fallen unconscious after his fire was taken. He says his vitals are fine, and he will recover shortly. The lights suddenly go out, and lava floods the room. Lloyd leads the others to break the chains binding them to the wall, which frees them (albeit, still being tied to each other.)

They get out of the crypt, all the while evading the rising lava and dragging Kai behind them. They return to the room of sarcophagi and find that they are filled with ancient Serpentine mummies.
