As the lava flows around them, the vipers return to life. The ninja attempt to fight back, but are unable while chained together.

They eventually escape and come across Hageman's skeleton once again. They find that it has several exploring tools in his backpack, and use them to further advance out of the pyramid. After passing through the wooden bridge again, they exit the temple to find that it is absolutely surrounded in lava, with no way of escaping.

They have failed each other. The ninja accepts their fate, and sit, making no more attempt to escape... Suddenly, P.I.X.A.L. arrives in the ShuriCopter to save them. She tells them that Lil Nelson told them where they were after Clutch Powers spread the news in Ninjago City.

Kai suddenly awakens, and the ninja rejoice. They make plans to now return to Ninjago City to stop Aspheera.

Snaketastrophy[]

The ninja arrive in Ninjago City just in time to save Fred Finely from being eaten by an Elemental Cobra. The reporter tells them that Aspheera is on her way to the Ninjago Museum of History with Gayle Gossip and her cameraman, Vinny.

The Ninja, after saving Fred Finely, take off for the museum, ready to defend the City and to stop Aspheera from getting the weapon that the Treacherous Deceiver used against Aspheera.

Powerless[]

Along their way to the Ninjago Museum of History, the ninja save the Police Commissioner and his crew before heading off to the Museum without Kai.

The ninja are able to get to the Scroll first, and upon Lloyd reading it, the scroll's power begins to rush through Lloyd's body and leaves him paralyzed before Nya knocks the scroll out of Lloyd's hands. After the ninja questioned what the scroll did to Lloyd, another door opens which turns out to be Aspheera and her army. With the scroll now on the ground, Char spots it, informs Aspheera, and both sides attack.

Zane fights the Elemental Cobras while Lloyd fights Aspheera and ultimately losses to her. She then performs Spinjitzu against the ninja and successfully defeats them. Aspheera then used her staff to destroy parts of the roof and cause the debris to fall on the Ninja. After that, she reawakens the Pyro Vipers still in their tombs and tells them to follow her out of the museum, and the Elemental Cobras to finish off the Ninja.

Before the Elemental Cobras destroy the Ninja, Jake comes in to shield the Ninja, but Kai catches up and rescues Jake out of trouble while turning on the fire sprinklers to distract the Elemental Cobras before Zane finishes them using his ice powers.

Ancient History[]

Lloyd, Zane, and Nya head off to stop Aspheera by taking a shortcut using Zane's GPS system. After arriving close to Aspheera, Zane headed off somewhere and promised to return.

When Lloyd and Nya were surrounded by Pyro Vipers, Zane arrives in his Shuricopter and creates an ice barrier, giving Lloyd and Nya enough time to escape.

Under Siege[]

While Lloyd, Nya, and Zane are in Ninjago City looking for Aspheera, Cole notifies them that she is on her way to the Monastery. In addition, he tells them to find Clutch Powers; believing he knows the second Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu's whereabouts.

When Lloyd, Nya, and Zane arrive at the Ninjago City Hospital, Clutch Powers tells them that the second scroll is at the Explorers Club, but he refuses to leave. When Nya pulls him from his bed, Clutch calls the nurses who escort the ninja away.

The Explorers Club[]

When Lloyd, Nya, and Zane enter the Explorers Club, they are welcomed by Cecil Putnam, and the trio explains that they need the second Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu. Luckily for them, the Explorers Club possessed the scroll; however, the ninja needed a membership for the club. Since the ninja didn't have a membership, they were pushed out from the building.

The ninja tried again, but this time, they used Zane disguised as Clutch Powers. Once Zane entered the building, he is confronted by Putnam who tells Zane that his membership had been suspended and cannot obtain any artifacts.

After the two failed attempts, Nya decided to be bold by sneaking in the building and stealing the scroll. Lloyd and Zane follow up, and all three reach the rooftop. The trio then shut down a fan by using Lloyd's sword and Zane's ice to prevent it from moving and made their way down the ventilator using a rope hook. Suddenly, the fan broke free causing the ninja to fall and crash into a middle of a meeting between Percy Shippelton, Smythe, and Underhill. Lloyd tried to come up with an excuse by saying they were working on the air conditioning, but his sword came tumbling down. Shippelton knew he was lying and calls for security, causing the ninja to flee into a room.

After more searching, Lloyd came across the Mirror of Dread and it showed his greatest fear of becoming his father. For Nya, her greatest fear was just being a normal citizen, and for Zane, his greatest fear was having no life. While Lloyd was talking to Zane, something crawled on Nya, causing her to freak out and throw the mysterious object onto Lloyd and Zane. Then, the door opened and the security guards tried to seize the Ninja, but they were able to enter another room.

Zane realized they entered the entomology room prompting Nya to tell Lloyd to not touch anything, but Nya knocked down a glass containing Venomasicus Tigrus which happened to have the second-most painful stings. The ninja tried to outrun the sworn of wasps, but they are stopped by Cecil Putnam and his security forces; nevertheless, the wasps attack them. Putnam is able to get away from the wasps and shoots a blowdart at Zane, but it deflects off him and hits a glass holding Vastodectrus Venomous which happens to have the most painful stings. Amongst the chaos, Nya told Lloyd and Zane to regroup and they enter another room.

This time, Nya found the second Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu, so they wrapped it up and exited the building, leaving everyone else inside the Explorers Club in disarray.

Vengeance is Mine![]

Zane and the others battle Aspheera, who used the power of the Scroll and her sorcery to make the Titan mech disappear instead. After his friends used the other scroll to battle Aspheera, she overcame them but after getting the scroll, Zane used the Scroll to freeze Aspheera and the Pyro Vipers. Jay questions Zane about how he was able to do that and Wu replies that it was the power of the Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu and asks Zane to give the Scroll to him. Under the influence, Zane hesitated to hand it over at first but regained his wits long enough to try and give the Scroll to Wu.

However, before Zane could, he noticed Aspheera had managed to break her arm free from the Ice and aimed her staff to use one final hit at Wu but Zane pushed his master out of harm's way causing him to be hit instead and was seemingly destroyed. The ninja, Wu, and P.I.X.A.L. were heartbroken that Zane was gone once more.

When visiting an imprisoned Aspheera, Wu criticized her for supposedly destroying his pupil. However, she informs him that Zane was not destroyed but banished to the Never-Realm, something that horrified him.

In a snowy area, the Titan Mech is laying on the ground while Zane's footprints are shown leading away from it.


Corruption[]

Zane fell from a portal in the sky and landed in the distant past of the Never-Realm, where he dropped the staff and found himself in another world. After waking up, he called out for help but received no answer and soon tried to repair the mech and find shelter. He attempted to create a board, but the crash landing had damaged him, so he had to reluctantly use the scroll. After dealing with an attacking Ice Bird, Zane makes an encampment in its cave. While repairing the mech, Zane records a message to anyone who finds it.

After the message, Zane attempted to reboot the mech, only for Vex, who had been tailing him since his arrival and after his failed attempt to use the Scroll, to remove the plug, erasing Zane’s memories as a result. Upon rebooting, Vex tells the amnesiac Zane that he is his advisor and that Zane is the Ice Emperor, who was overthrown. Handing Zane his scepter, he tells him that they can take back what is "theirs."

Manipulated by the Formling, Zane uses the staff holding the scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu to attack Grimfax at his castle. Zane subsequently overpowered and turned most of the soldiers to his side by corrupting them and forced Grimfax into submission. Given new armor, Zane officially became the Ice Emperor with Vex serving as his advisor. He then sent an eternal winter across the land.

Time in the Never-Realm[]

At some point, Zane created the Ice Dragon Boreal and was slowly corrupted by the Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu, with his face becoming deformed by ice from the over usage of the staff, which became covered in ice while his voice changed by becoming distorted and deeper. He then created the Blizzard Samurai, Blizzard Sword Masters, and other Blizzard Archers. He later ordered the deaths of the Yeti and conquered the realm as the Ice Emperor.

The Last of the Formlings (flashback)[]

After the Formlings didn't pledge alliance to Vex, the General persuaded the Ice Emperor to attack the Formlings' Village after lying to him that they are war driven tribe and a threat. The Ice Emperor and Boreal proceeded to freeze the village of the Formlings, leaving Akita to be the only survivor. With the Formlings gone, the trio left the area to continue their reign of terror on the realm and took Kataru as a prize, while having him imprisoned.

The Never-Realm[]

When General Vex went to his throne room, Ice Emperor questions him on why he had disturbed his thoughts. Vex tells him that strangers had come to the Never-Realm, are looking for their prisoner and want to stop his rule. Ice Emperor says that the strangers should be punished, but Vex suggests that they should be destroyed. The Ice Emperor agrees and orders for his samurai to destroy the strangers and adds those who aid them to the lists once Vex suggests it.

The Message[]

Lloyd came across Zane's message when he stumbled upon his camp. In the message, Zane stated he had lost track of how many days it has been since he was banished to the Never-Realm. He spent his time trying to repair the mech but was unable to finish it and had now given up hope of ever being rescued. He told the viewer to give his friends a message:

"This is the last recording of Zane. Master of Ice. Son of Dr. Julien. Student of Master Wu. I was built to protect those who cannot protect themselves. I have tried to fulfill this purpose. I have no regrets. I had the best friends anyone could ask for. P.I.X.A.L., I love you. Farewell."

Secret of the Wolf[]

When the remaining Blizzard Samurai return to the castle, Grimfax steps forward to report their victory. Vex is quick to tell them that they actually failed, after displaying the fire still remains and how their numbers are lacking. Ice Emperor is displeased at this and starts to freeze Grimfax whom Vex persuaded him to punish. However, he stops midway and tells Grimfax that he will atone for his mistake. When Vex tells him of a green outfit stranger approaching, he seems to be momentarily perplexed by this news. He determines to finish the Ice Fishers with Boreal and says that "the green one will meet a different fate."

Later, Ice Emperor summons Boreal from his resting spot with his staff.

My Enemy, My Friend[]

When Boreal injures Lloyd, he is instructed to bring him to Ice Emperor. Vex brings him before the emperor. When Lloyd recovered from his trance, he comes face to face with the Emperor is shocked to see his friend corrupted by the Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu.

A Fragile Hope[]

When Lloyd referred to the Emperor by his real name Zane, he was confused, not remembering Ninjago, Wu, P.I.X.A.L. or Kai. Lloyd continued to try and get through to him by reminding him of his banishment and asking if he remembered the time Lloyd once turned his white gi pink; all of which Vex convinces him are just lies.

Believing it was the Scroll corrupting him due to holding it for decades (due to being sent to the past of the Never-Realm,) Lloyd attempts to take it from the Emperor but is incapacitated by him. As Vex tries to persuade him into killing his friend, the Emperor instead orders him to have the unconscious Lloyd thrown in the dungeon, and harshly orders him to comply.

Once and for All[]

When Akita burst into the throne room, the Emperor was disturbed by her presence and fought her, thinking she was after his scepter as well. He learns that she wanted revenge for the freezing of her people, the Formlings, who the Emperor states were war driven because of what Vex told him.

The two fought until he froze her and moved to finish the latter before Lloyd showed up to finish their talk.

Awakenings[]

Still denying his past, the Ice Emperor fights Lloyd as well as froze Akita until he froze him by the steps. Vex then attempted to get his master to kill his friend, but he relents.

When Vex planned on doing it himself and said the word "protect." this got Zane to remember what his father told him about protecting those who cannot protect themselves and soon recovered every memory he had while breaking free of his corruption. As Vex prepared to kill Lloyd, Zane quickly blocks the attack before removing the lower part of his helmet, returning his face to normal, and struck the Formling aside before destroying his scepter, returning the Never-Realm back to its original state.

Zane proceeded to help Lloyd to his feet as his friend was happy to see him back to normal. Thanking him for restoring his memory, he inquired about their friends before he saw that Vex was attempting to kill him but was frozen in place, defeating the corrupt general. The other ninja soon arrive and see Zane back to his old self, and the latter greets them with a hug.

Sometime later, Grimfax took back power and he along with the Formlings agreed Zane wasn't to blame for their suffering, as they all came to the mutual decision to banish Vex, the one responsible to the outskirts of the realm for his crimes. Zane returns to the Great Lake with his friends and learns there was no way to return to Ninjago until Cole finds a way by showing the berry he had been saving and a portal is open.

Returning home, Zane greets his Master Wu who hugged him before Zane has a touching reunion with P.I.X.A.L., who happily embraces him.

Prime Empire & Prime Empire Original Shorts

Prime Empire & Prime Empire Original Shorts[]

Upgrade[]

Zane and the rest of the ninja were chasing The Mechanic after he robbed a bank. However, The Mechanic was able to flee quickly. When Nya and Jay join the ninja late, Lloyd asked about their previous whereabouts and Jay and Nya lied about what they actually did.

Would You Like to Enter Prime Empire?[]

Zane and the other ninja apprehend the Mechanic at a warehouse where he is attempting to steal some sort of motherboard. Zane is knocked over by the Mechanic and his henchmen while the rest of the ninja attempt to steal the motherboard back from him.

The Mechanic escapes with the motherboard and the ninja board the Katana 4x4 and chase after him. They pursue The Mechanic on the streets, but he pushes the Katana 4x4 onto a building, which causes it to lose control and stay behind. Cole remains on The Mechanic's tail, sticking a cable to his truck and tying it to a pole, which ultimately causes the truck to malfunction. As soon as The Mechanic gets out of his Noodle Truck, the ninja surround him. Jay takes the motherboard from The Mechanic, but is confused by its design.

The ninja decide to examine The Mechanic's headquarters, where Jay finds an old arcade cabinet for an old legendary game called Prime Empire. He attempts to plug it in but to no avail. He offers to stay behind to investigate while the others explore the rest of the hideout.

Zane and the others find the Mechanic's many hats when all of a sudden feel a surge of energy and a red light.

Kai sees notes with the same logo on the motherboard on The Mechanic's bulletin board, and Lloyd finds a notebook which also has the logo. A monitor boots up behind some books, so Zane pushes them aside to see it. The monitor questions the ninja if they found the motherboard, and Zane responds typing in the keyboard. The monitor replies back, saying that Unagami is pleased that they found the motherboard and tells them to activate Prime Empire, then turns itself off. Lloyd questions on who Unagami is, and return to Jay, and find that he’d disappeared...

Dyer Island[]

Zane and the others call for Jay after he mysteriously disappears from the Mechanic's hideout. Zane points out that there is always an explanation for these types of things.

Nya fiddles with the Prime Empire arcade cabinet, and finds that it opens up to a secret chamber. Cole points to a security camera nearby, and Zane boots it up to a computer. The ninja watch as Jay releases some sort of energy wave from the Prime Empire game, then he disappears through it. They realize that this is no ordinary game, and maybe to find Jay, they also have to play the game. Zane points out that this would be dangerous, and they need answers first.

The ninja go to the police station where they begin to interrogate The Mechanic. Zane has searched the database for all known criminals, and points out that Unagami doesn't show up. The Mechanic reveals that Unagami can control the database, and will eventually control it all.

The Commissioner enters and announces to everyone that all over Ninjago City, Prime Empire is booting up on consoles that were never originally meant to play the game. Kai wonders if that pulse of energy that they saw shoot out from the game on the security footage has anything to do with it...

The Mechanic laughs and says "it's starting, just like he said." He avoids more of the Ninja's questions, and the Commissioner takes him away as he laughs and repeats what he said earlier.

Zane says that Prime Empire was created by a man named Milton Dyer. If anyone can tell them about the game, it's him.

The ninja board the Bounty and Zane pulls up a picture of Dyer. Zane reveals that nobody has seen him in 30 years, and that they are on their way to his island, Dyer Island.

They arrive, and find that the front gate and garden are run-down and overgrown. They traverse through a hedge maze, overgrown with plant life and vines, and then enter the courtyard. They knock on the front door of the Dyer Mansion, but get catapulted away. Realizing that they set off the whole security system, the ninja are attacked by several more booby-traps, including robot dogs, and statues that shoot lasers at them.

The booby-traps suddenly cease, and a man in a bathrobe comes up to them. Cole mistakes him for Milton Dyer, but he reveals his name is Bob the Intern.

Bob apologizes for the mishap, he was in the shower. He invites them into the Mansion, and tells them how he's worked for Dyer for 31 years. Milton Dyer hasn't been around in a long time... Bob has been waiting for his return.

The ninja ask Bob about Prime Empire, and Bob pulls up a VHS tape of Milton explaining the game. He created this tape the day he finished the game.

Dyer says that Prime Empire is not just a game, but a ticket to another world... almost like magic. The VHS suddenly cuts out after a bright light entrances Dyer, and he walks into it. The ninja remember something very similar happening to Jay...

Bob takes the VHS tape out and tells them that something went wrong with the game. Milton Dyer was fired from Vast Industries because of "creative differences." Prime Empire was never released because Dyer made unauthorized changes to the game. Bob reveals that Dyer told him that "they'd be sorry one day."

Zane and the others realize with all these clues . . . Milton Dyer is Unagami.

Gayle Gossip: A Closer Look[]

While Benny was advertising his arcade, Zane interrupts the broadcast by telling Gayle Gossip that Prime Empire is dangerous. However, Benny interrupts and continues to advertise.

Level Thirteen[]

Zane and the other ninja arrive at Borg Tower to find out if Cyrus Borg has found any more information about Prime Empire. Borg is intrigued by Milton Dyer’s technology. He reveals to them that it’s even more complex than his Digiverse.

He also says that over 800 players, including Jay, are trapped in the game, and the game is controlled by Milton Dyer from the outside.

Borg says that there are two ways to stop Unagami, find his Avatar in the game, and seek out Dyer in real life. He says that Zane and P.I.X.A.L. cannot enter the game or else the code of the game could overwrite their memory, so the two of them will search for Dyer in real life. Cole boots up the game to reach level 13 so that he and the others can enter and find Jay.

Zane and the others soon see that The Mechanic, Ultra Violet, and Captain Soto have broken out of Kryptarium Prison and are on their way to them. Borg tells them to let his security system deal with them so they can stay behind to work on beating the game.

The others watch as Cole pounds away at the controls, meanwhile the Kryptarium prisoners continue to make their way through the tower.

The prisoners finally reach the 100th floor, and Zane fends them off with the others while Cole finally reaches level 13. While fighting the Ninja, The Mechanic reveals that Unagami wants him to serve at his side as his “Player 2.”

The Prime Empire console opens and Cole begs the others in. Zane wishes Lloyd luck inside the game, and Lloyd wishes him luck in finding Dyer.

Borg takes Zane and P.I.X.A.L. to the roof to fly off on his private helicopter. P.I.X.A.L. worries what The Mechanic will do with the original game, but Zane reveals that he yanked out the Prime Empire motherboard just before Cole went through, leaving the villains unable to enter the game.

One Step Forward, Two Steps Back[]

As Wu, Zane, and P.I.X.A.L. made their way through the Ninjago slums, a place Zane acknowledged to be Milton Dyer's childhood home. Given the revelation that Milton might be Unagami, Zane emphasized the importance of the Dyer family's involvement in any investigation concerning their son. Wu, however, reminded them to handle the situation delicately, a point Zane accepted. Upon reaching the house, they were welcomed by Mrs. Dyer, who listened intently as they explained their search for her son. She expressed her surprise, acknowledging that she was aware of the chaos stemming from Prime Empire. While Mrs. Dyer spoke, Zane and P.I.X.A.L. noticed a photograph of a young Milton alongside a friend, though Mrs. Dyer struggled to recall the friend's name. She implored Zane and the others to bring her son back home safely. Grateful for her cooperation, they thanked her before leaving.

Ninjago Confidential[]

Using a silly detective voice, Zane narrates the story so far. Using cliches from classic detective stories, Zane tells a nonexistent audience that he and P.I.X.A.L. are tracking down a lead that will lead them to Milton Dyer.

P.I.X.A.L. approaches Zane and is confused with Zane's sudden change of personality. Zane tells her that he downloaded hundreds of detective movies, and has adopted the same methodology as them in solving mysteries, as everything else he's tried has failed. Annoyed at the silliness of Zane's new attitude, she reveals that she found a lead. Milton Dyer's friend from the photo from his childhood works at Laughy's Karaoke club.

They enter the club, and all eyes are on them. Zane narrating the state of the club and his blunt observations of the people inside cause several men to get angry. One man, who introduces himself as Fugi-Dove's brother, starts a fight, and Zane and his partner engage with the rest of the people in the club, and a fight breaks out.

With Zane narrating his every move, his opponent is able to gain the advantage on him. When Zane is cornered, P.I.X.A.L. steps in to help him out. Once the fight subsides, the barman reveals that he is the one they are looking for.

He introduces himself as Tony, says that he and Dyer were friends when they were kids. Apparently, Dyer had a spot he often went when he needed inspiration he called "Videogame City," inside a pizzeria called Buddy's Pizza.

Buddy's got shut down after the City's "videogame prohibition," that started after the disappearances of the children playing Prime Empire. Zane and P.I.X.A.L. go inside and find nothing out of the ordinary, until the Mechanic arrives and pins them down. Zane is knocked into an arcade cabinet where he short-circuits and blacks out, and P.I.X.A.L. is knocked out cold. When she wakes up, she realizes the Mechanic captured Zane, as he isn't around.

The Prodigal Father[]

Zane wakes up in the Mechanic's warehouse with a blindfold over his eyes and unable to move. He then hears the Mechanic himself taunt him before ordering one of his henchman to remove his blindfold. Once it's taken off, Zane sees himself chained up in a chair and surrounded by the villain and his goons. The Mechanic then reveals his goal: creating the Manifestation Gate that allows Unagami to enter the real world. Zane points out that the energy required to transport the game information into the real world would have to be massive, to which the Mechanic points out that that's why so many kids get trapped in the game, so their energy can be harvested to be used to fuel the portal.

To finish their preparations, all the Mechanic needs left is the Prime Empire motherboard, which Zane says he destroyed. In order to goad him into telling the truth, the Mechanic reveals to have captured Master Wu.

After having threatened to hurt him, Zane breaks and reveals that he hid the motherboard in his chest. The Mechanic takes it and inserts it into the Manifestation Gate, powering it up.

The Mechanic reveals that the last thing he needs... is Zane. Using his power source, he is going to hook him up to the gate and channel his energy to stabilize the gate. Zane objects, pointing out this could destroy him, but the Mechanic is apathetic.

The henchmen drag Zane to the gate and chain him up. The Mechanic plugs him into the mechanism and lights it up, causing his power to be sapped. P.I.X.A.L. arrives and attempts to deal with the henchmen, but it is too late, and the gate is opened...

Game Over[]

The gate has been opened, and Prime Empire enemies begin to pour out of the portal. Zane continues to struggle in his chains as he is used to power the portal. Seeing this, P.I.X.A.L. helps him out, when Jay arrives on the Blue Dragon. Zane is unhooked, and recovers. He notices that Jay isn't with the rest of the Ninja, and he is told that the four of them have been turned into energy cubes used to fuel the gate.

Jay begins rambling on about what to do next, and makes a plan to get Unagami and Dyer to reconcile. He reveals that Unagami isn't necessarily evil, but confused. Dyer, who P.I.X.A.L. brought with her, reveals he had no idea Unagami was alive, and made a mistake shutting the game down. Jay forms a plan, and orders the others to get Dyer to the top of Borg Tower, while he lures Unagami there.

Unagami, who has taken the form of a massive dragon, scours the city searching for his creator, as he and the other video game characters wreak havoc on the City. Jay finds him, and chases him to the tower. Meanwhile, Zane, the others, and Dyer make their way there as well.

Having reached the top of the tower, they find Jay and Unagami already there. Jay has confronted him, and tries to convince him that being angry is of no use. Dyer interrupts and attempts to reason with his creation.

He reveals why he abandoned Unagami, and tells him he was not made to instill fear and suffering, but joy. Revealing his true form, as a young boy, Unagami reminds his creator that he abandoned him. Dyer says he was scared of what he created, panicked, and shut the game down at the orders of Vast Industries.

He apologizes to Unagami, and hopes to make amends, to bring him home. Unagami returns to his child form, and releases all of the players that he took from gate, as well as returning the players who choose to back to the game.

All of the lost players return from the gate, including the rest of the Ninja. Zane, Jay, Wu, and P.I.X.A.L. reunite with their friends, and Cole asks where Unagami is. Jay then replies by saying that he's where he belongs: home.

Master of the Mountain

Master of the Mountain[]

Shintaro[]

Weeks after the battle with Unagami, the ninja are cleaning up the Monastery after being gone for so long. Zane is assisting P.I.X.A.L. with fixing the sentry cannons.

The Mailman soon arrives and delivers an invitation to the Ninja. The invitation is to the Ivory City of Shintaro, which Zane points out are exceedingly rare. The city is the most beautiful city in the world, and the people there have wings. The King Vangelis invites the ninja to his city to celebrate his daughter Vania's birthday.

Zane points out that little is known about the Kingdom of Shintaro, except that up until recently, it was still considered mythical.

The ninja board the Bounty and fly through the beautiful Mountains of Shintaro. Zane says that his optic circuits can't even convey the grandeur of the moment. While admiring the view, the ninja are suddenly attacked by a vicious species of bat called Dire Bats.

The bats wreck havoc on the ship, which causes its sails to fall, and the Bounty goes lopsided. The heroes prepare for impact when the Bounty suddenly starts floating again. To their amazement, the ship is being supported by the Army of Shintaro.

The ninja are greeted by Hailmar, the right hand of King Vangelis, who welcomes them to the Kingdom of Shintaro. He explains that the Bats are the reason why people rarely visit the city. As they pass the mountains, the heroes come into full view of the beautiful Ivory City.

Into the Dark[]

The ninja are astounded by the beauty of the city and are taken by Hailmar to the throne room where they meet King Vangelis. The King welcomes them and introduces the royal Princess Vania. It was her idea to invite the Ninja, as she is a big fan of them. She asks them all sorts of questions about their adventures and takes an interest in Cole.

Vangelis takes the heroes to their quarters, where they will sleep for the night to prepare for the party tomorrow.

Late at night, Cole assembles the ninja in the 47th-floor lobby. Cole explains to the groggy ninja that he saw a creature in his bedroom, and it disappeared. The weirdest part was that the creature was holding his mother's necklace.

The ninja are skeptical and believe that Cole may have dreamed the scenario up. Without any proper evidence to convince them, the ninja are convinced that Cole made it up. Wu suggests that he goes back to sleep, and the seven of them can discuss it in the morning. The other ninja return to bed, with Cole still feeling troubled.

The Worst Rescue Ever[]

Zane and the other ninja are strolling through the magnificent gardens, and realize that Cole is missing.

Suddenly, Princess Vania appears from out of a tunnel in a frenzy, telling the ninja that she went into the Dungeons with Cole and found something terrible. There's an underground mine filled with little creatures forced to mine by black skeletons. Cole stayed behind to rescue them and told her to get help.

The seven of them go to tell King Vangelis, and he is angry at his daughter for disobeying his orders, endangering their guests. He says that he'll send his guards down at once to find Cole, but he will not allow the ninja to go. The ninja realize that the creature that Cole saw in his bedroom was real all along.

The ninja leave the throne room and make secret plans to enter the dungeons behind the King's orders. Vania agrees to show them the way into the dungeons, and she leads the way back to the garden.

Wu agrees to stay behind with Vania, feeling as though he'll slow the rest of them down. The ninja enter the cave and find that Vania was telling the truth. Zane detects simple weapons and crude fortifications from the skeletons, and the others suggest that they bust up the bags of bones, and rescue Cole nice and quickly.

They all agree, and steal the keys to Cole's cage, and free him at last. In order to delay their capture, Zane blocks an entrance off for the skeletons with his shuriken. Cole tells them to keep the volume down, as there's a winged masked man who lives in the temple in the center.

The two tribes of creatures that live in the dungeons, the Geckles and Munce, start to quarrel with each other, causing a ruckus. This alerts the Re-Awakened, who begin to attack the Ninja. Lloyd orders Jay and Nya to take our the warriors, while the rest of them run away. Zane and the others are in shock, watching the Geckles and Munce call each other "blade stealers." Meanwhile, the ninja find that the Re-Awakened go down without much trouble.

While trying to defend themselves, Zane realizes that his Elemental Powers are no use in the dungeons.

All the commotion causes the masked man to exit his temple. The man reveals himself as the Skull Sorcerer, a masked man in a black gown with wings, wielding a glowing green skull. The Skull Sorcerer uses the green skull in his hands to awaken the black skeletons around him, overwhelming the Ninja, leading to their defeat and eventual capture.

The Two Blades[]

Zane and the other ninja are put to work by the Re-Awakened, forced to mine heaping amounts of Vengestone, which explains their inability to use their powers.

After causing a ruckus, they are locked up in a cage with several Geckles. When one Geckle picks a fight with an approaching Munce, the ninja begin to wonder where their feud started.

The Geckle explains that long ago, a hero named Gilly (who the Munce argues was named "Milly,") entered the mountain with two blades to defend the Geckles and Munce from a terrible dragon known as Grief-Bringer (who the Munce argues was called "Mief-Bringer.") After defeating the dragon, "Gilly" left behind her blades as gifts to the Geckles and Munce— leaving the Ivory Blade of Deliverance to the Geckles, and the Shadow Blade of Deliverance to the Munce.

The two tribe's feud started when the Munce apparently stole their blade, however, the Munce argues that the Geckles were the ones that stole the blade. The ninja come to the conclusion that it was actually the Skull Sorcerer who stole both blades, in order to get control over both tribes. While the tribes fight over themselves, they can't fight the Skull Sorcerer.

Lloyd puts together a plan to get the two tribes to make a truce so they can all break out. Word is passed around through Geckles and Munce about a secret meeting after lunch, and when the time comes, they discuss retrieving both Blades by defeating the Skull Sorcerer.

Later, the ninja break out of their cages by getting a Mino to eat through their chains. The ninja split up, while Cole and Lloyd attempt to find the two blades, Zane and the others go about releasing the remaining Geckles and Munce. A few minutes later, chaos ensues, as Cole and Lloyd are chased away by the Skull Sorcerer.

In the commotion, the ninja are split up so that Jay, Nya, and Lloyd go one path, while Zane and Kai go down another. Cole is further separated from the group as he is chased by the Skull Sorcerer.

Trial By Mino[]

Zane and Kai walk for over an hour in the caves after being separated from the other Ninja. On one of their several loops around, noticing the same rock over and over again, a group of three Geckles arrive singing a song retelling the story of "Gilly" liberating them from the terrible dragon and gifting them the Ivory Blade of Deliverance.

One of the Geckles spills moss-milk onto Kai, which reveals their location to them. The Geckles mistake them for Re-Awakened and take the two of them to the Geckle Strong-Cave to meet with Chancellor Gulch.

Zane and Kai meet the Geckle's Chancellor, who decides to test whether the two ninja are truly skeletons or not through a trial by Mino. Kai and Zane are then dropped down below the Geckles Court into a dungeon where they are forced to fight a Mino.

Unable to use both their Elemental Powers and Spinjitzu against the beast, Zane deduces that the Mino is not angry by nature, and takes off its uncomfortable armor to calm it down, defeating it.

Gulch declares the two of them "not skeletons," and notices that the two of them are Elemental Masters, similar to the legendary Gilly. Gulch asks them if they know Gilly, but they do not. Gulch then decides to promote Kai to Chancellor Red Ninja, Who is Not a Skeleton. Kai's first real motion as Chancellor is to learn the origins of the Skull Sorcerer.

Gulch takes the two ninja to the Geckles' Story Cave, where he reiterates the story of Gilly freeing them from the dragon, and the Munce stealing their Blade. He then goes on to say that the story of the Skull Sorcerer began with three adventures who ventured into the old tunnels where Geckles are forbidden. They awoke an ancient evil from the "old world," that being Hazza D'ur, and the Skull Sorcerer rose with his army of re-awakened warriors. He then forced the Geckles and Munce to be put to work mining Vengestone.

Zane and Kai realize that the Skul Sorcerer is the Geckles and Munce's common enemy, and as Kai's next act as Chancellor, he motions that the Geckles and Munce work together to stop this great evil— although it might take some convincing.

Grief-Bringer[]

The Geckles argue over whether the Munce are to be trusted, and so the former Chancellor proposes a "matter by slug," to decide whether to trust the new Munce Queen.

The slug race starts, the rule is if the Ninjas' slug wins, the Munce can be trusted, if not, they ambush them. In the middle of the race, a Geckle named Gleck approaches Kai and Zane. He reveals that he believes them, that the Munce are not their enemies. While talking, Kai notices Gleck's necklace and realizes that he is the same Geckle that Cole saw in his room the other day. Looking inside the necklace, the ninja find pictures of Cole's parents, Lou, and his mother Lilly. Realizing that the legendary "Gilly" is actually Lilly, Kai tells Gleck that she, unfortunately, passed away a little while ago, however, they promise that they will help them, and stop the Skull Sorcerer.

The ninja return to the slug race and Zane uses his powers to cheat in the race to get their slug to win. The Geckles are in agreement, and the meeting is on.

On the way to the meeting, Zane and Kai are fitted with gold armor over their ninja suits as a precaution in case the Munce try to ambush them. Finally, they arrive at the meeting spot and discover that the new Munce Queen is none other than Nya, who is accompanied by Jay and Lloyd. The ninja finally reunite and are hopeful for the Skull Sorcerer's defeat.

Suddenly, they are all attacked by the fearsome dragon known as Grief-Bringer, resurrected by the Skull Sorcerer. Nya Kai and Jay lead the Geckles and Munce to safety, while Lloyd and Zane keep the dragon back.

They manage to knock it over, only for it to get back up. The two ninja quickly run away, followed by the Skull Sorcerer and his army. Kai and Zane make it over a lava pit and reconvene with the others, while the Skull Sorcerer watches them flee, saying that grief is coming for them.

The Darkest Hour[]

Zane, the Ninja, and the Munce and Geckles continue to run for their lives from Grief-Bringer and the Skull Sorcerer's army. They soon approach the Geckle Strong-Cave, where the former Chancellor agrees to temporarily let the Munce in. Once inside, the dragon and army of skeletons are fast approaching, and the door is stuck.

In order to slow them down, Kai, Jay, Zane, and Lloyd defend the Strong-Cave. The door is finally shut, and the four ninja make it back inside.

Now that they are safe for now, the Geckles and Munce are still at odds. From outside the door, the Skull Sorcerer promises to spare the two tribe's lives if they hand over the Ninja— both of them decline the offer, and Grief-Bringer continues its attack on the cave.

After realizing that their hope to escape is futile and that their common enemy is the Skull Sorcerer, the Geckles and Munce put aside their differences and agree to a truce.

Grief-Bringer manages to break through the cave door and prepares to attack, but Lloyd stops them, saying that the ninja will surrender, so long as the Skull Sorcerer no longer forces the Geckles and Munce to do his work. The Skull Sorcerer agrees, and the ninja are taken by the skeletons. Unfortunately, the Sorcerer lied, and the Geckles and Munce are surrounded by the Awakened Warriors...

The Upply Strike Back![]

The Geckles and Munce are now put back to work, and the five ninja are locked in a cage... The Skull Sorcerer comes to them and tells them that he will make an example of them, and use Grief-Bringer to end them. The ninja are confident that Cole will return with King Vangelis and put a stop to him, but the Skull Sorcerer reveals that he is King Vangelis and that he cast Cole, Vania, and Wu down the mountain to their doom.

The ninja mourn the loss of their friend and their Master, and the Skull Sorcerer prepares to release Grief-Bringer from his cage. All of a sudden, the Geckles and Munce are freed from their chains, as Cole and Wu have returned with four new allies: The Upply.

Plundar and Adam of the Upply arrive and break the ninja out of their cage. The five of them join the Geckles and Munce against their fight with the Re-Awakened, meanwhile, Cole is in a duel with the Skull Sorcerer, using the two Blades of Deliverance that once belonged to his mother.

The Son of Lilly[]

Grief-Bringer is released from its cage and begins to fight against the Ninja, Geckles, and Munce. While Cole continues to battle the Skull Sorcerer, Princess Vania arrives with the entire Shintaro Army to help against the Re-Awakened.

While fighting the Sorcerer, Cole unlocks the Spinjitzu Burst, a power his mother used to defeat Grief-Bringer long ago, and destroys the Skull of Hazza D'ur, causing King Vangelis to lose his powers. The Shintaro fleet apprehends Vangelis, and he is taken away.

Much later, all of the Geckles and Munce, as well as the ninja and the Upply, gather in the Kingdom of Shintaro to celebrate Princes Vania being crowned Queen of Shintaro. She promises to uphold the laws of the land, and protect the people of the above, and below.

Now it is time for the ninja to say their goodbyes. They board the Bounty and head off for home— However, Wu says that he wishes to continue onward to another adventure. When asked where they will go next, he says wherever the wind takes them.

The Island

The Island[]

Uncharted[]

Cecil Putnam, manager of the Explorer's Club arrives at the Monastery with the unfortunate news that Misako's membership has been revoked, effective immediately, on the grounds that she is presumed lost at sea. The ninja are concerned with Misako, who is revealed to have been on an expedition along with Wu and Clutch Powers attempting to navigate the storm belt off the coast of southern Ninjago. She was attempting to prove her theory of an uncharted island, but has not made contact with the club for several weeks, and is now considered by them to be lost.

Later, P.I.X.A.L. explains that the storm belt is an area off the southern coast plagued by storms, where numerous ships are known to have gone missing. Zane says that to his knowledge, there is only one person to have emerged from the storm belt, a man named Timothy Batterson. He was part of a balloon tour that was blown off coarse, and eventually crashed on this uncharted island. Lloyd orders the team to find out where this Timothy Batterson is, and to pack for the trip.

The team arrives at Batterson's place of residence, and are greeted by the man, who wears unkempt clothes tattered from an apparently treacherous journey. Batterson introduces himself as "Twitchy Tim," and offers the ninja fuel for their ship. Lloyd questions Tim about the island, but Tim is unwilling to help. He goes into a frenzy, twitching every few moments, yelling about monsters and storms that make the island extremely dangerous. Tim reveals that he was struck by lightning 12 times there. He twitches again, and asks the ninja once again what type of fuel they would prefer. Lloyd tries to steer the conversation back to the island, and discusses that they are desperate for help, as Tim is the only person who can help them navigate. Tim denies their request again, and after a series of twitches, once again asks them what their preferred fuel is. He eventually comes around, and boards the ship.

The team, along with Twitchy Tim, make their way to Southern Ninjago, and enter the storm belt. Their radar is unable to see past the fog belt, and Twitchy warns them that the island does not want them to find her.

Tim tells them the story of how he became stranded, and reveals that he spent days afloat in his air balloon in the fog, when he was apparently knocked out, and woke up on the blue sanded shores of the uncharted island.

The bounty continues through the storm, and P.I.X.A.L warns them that there is a sharp rise in electrostatic levels, meaning it would be unwise to continue in the storm on the bounty. She deploys catamarans for the ninja to board, and they make their way through the waves this way. Each of the ninja board the ships, and maneuver through a bank of sharp stones, which Zane notes attract the strange purple lightning that surrounds them.

They finally reach the blue sanded shores of the island, and P.I.X.A.L. deploys jungle choppers to the Ninja's location so they can more easily navigate. Three sets of bikes arrive, and the ninja take off. Further down the beach they find Misako and Wu's settlement, which is now abandoned. Zane points out a rock formation nearby that spells out "help," and they come to the conclusion that this was left here in case anyone came after them. They make it their mission to find them, and take the choppers further into the jungle. Twitchy warns them of monsters that look like statues, but the ninja are prepared, and take off.

The Keepers of the Amulet[]

Zane and the others continue through the jungle, and make note of an animal that appears to be following them through the bushes. They eventually come to a dead end, and prepare to take the rest of the way on foot.

They are suddenly met with the animal that followed them, which is revealed to be a docile dragon, whom Jay names Zippy. He appears to be friendly, and loving of coconuts. While the ninja play fetch with Zippy, Lloyd recommends that they get back on track with finding his mother and uncle. Nya sends a coconut off into the distance, to which Zippy chases after, and the ninja continue through the brush.

As they make their way through the jungle, they find a stone totem, which suddenly comes alive and begins attacking them. Two other totems appear, and a battle ensues between the lot of them. The ninja are unable to damage them, and quickly discover that the totems channel the team's Elemental Energy, and spits it back at them. Twitchy Tim runs away in fear, and the ninja are soon to follow, realizing that they are unable to defeat these stone golems.

The ninja make a run for it, and soon realize that in their desperate attempt at escape, they have lost Lloyd and Tim. The five remaining ninja reach a cliff, and discover a rickety rope bridge. They make their way across safely, and continue on their escape. Zane and Jay are the last ones across, and discover that Kai, Nya, and Cole have disappeared. They hear something that sounds like an electrostatic shock, but are unable to comprehend what it was, as the two of them are shocked by purple lightning, and are knocked unconscious.

The ninja awake soon after, strapped to catamarans piloted by men with glowing purple skin. The catamarans are outfitted with glowing purple stones, reminiscent of their captures skin and the lightning that surrounds the island. The men lead the ninja to their side of the island, and are brought to the throne room of their leader.

Their leader, who is adorned with traditional tribal ornaments, mistakenly assumes that the ninja have come to the island to steal "the amulet," which many others have attempted to steal. The ninja attempt to tell him that he is wrong, but the leader does not believe them. He introduces himself as the chief of the Keepers of the Amulet, and they have made it their vow to protect the Storm Amulet, an artifact that was pried from the head of the Sleeper of the Deep, she who existed long before Time had a name, Wojira. The Keepers took a sacred oath to protect the Storm Amulet from those who seek it, and harnessed the power of lightning and become one with the storms. Their forefathers kept the oath, and theirs before them, all the way back to the beginning.

Zane attempts to persuade him to let them go, as they have no intention of stealing their artifact, but seeing as how they have seen it, the Keepers will take them prisoner forever, in the name of Wojira.

The Gift of Jay[]

Zane and the others are surrounded by the Keepers. Their chief orders that the ninja be locked up, all but one, and refers to this individual as "the gift." Jay pipes up and questions if all the pushing, poking, and stabbing is really necessary. He introduces himself to them, and the chief orders the Keepers to take him as the gift. Jay is taken away, to the dismay of the others, and the remaining four ninja are locked up.

The ninja are shoved into a cell by the Keepers, and discover that Wu, Misako, and Clutch Powers are locked in there with them. Misako reveals that the Keepers have treated them quite well, and it seems that the tribe are less violent than they are just protective of the amulet. Nya and Cole question whether Clutch had actually intended to steal the artifact, to which he at first denies, but eventually comes clean and says his intention was to study it and bring it back to his place.

Kai tells Misako that Jay has been taken by the Keepers, and Lloyd is still out there, probably on his way now to look for them. Moments later, Lloyd arrives and breaks them out of their cell, with the help of Zippy the dragon. Lloyd reunites with his mother and uncle, and they split up to locate Jay.

Eventually, the lot of them reconvene, none of them having found Jay. They soon come to realize that Clutch isn't with them either, and wonder if he is stupid enough to go back to the altar to steal the Amulet.

The ninja return to the Storm Amulet's altar and find Clutch trying to take the artifact off its perch. The ninja try to convince him to put it back, and Zane warns that the Keepers are likely to return. Moments later, the group is zapped by the Keepers' lightning staffs, and they are knocked out.

They eventually regain consciousness and find that each of them have been strapped to poles on the beach overlooking a sacrifice. The Keepers' chief reveals that Wojira has awakened, and the only way to appease her is with a human sacrifice. Jay is then carried over to the edge of the docks, where he is strapped to a boat, and is revealed to be said sacrifice, "the gift of Jay."

The other ninja watch in horror as their friend is cast out to sea, and a great beast looms in the fog.

The Tooth of Wojira[]

Jay yells out that he sees something in the water, and describes it as an enormous sea serpent. The ninja worry that it is indeed Wojira, and they break through their ropes to save their friend. They meet opposition from the Keepers, but make their way to the edge of the docks safely. Zane freezes a path over the sea for them to walk on as they chase after Jay's raft.

They eventually reach him, and discover that the beast is getting ever closer, shooting fire balls at them that just barely miss hitting them.

They approach Jay, and Lloyd tries to undo his ties, but he is too late, and the beast swallows him. The ninja are heartbroken as Jay is cast away by the monster, but Lloyd has his doubts. The group returns to the island shore, and confront the Keepers about sacrificing their friend to a monster. Lloyd reveals that whatever they just sacrificed Jay to was not Wojira. He reveals that it was a contraption, due to the wooden tooth that fell of it, and that the Keepers have been conned.

Lloyd demands that the Keepers chief tell them the truth about why they protect the amulet. He starts from the very beginning, and reveals that the First Spinjitzu Master tasked them with guarding the artifact thousands of years ago, and if it were ever to return to the sea, the great storm spirit Wojira would flood the world. Wojira had been sleeping at the bottom of the sea for a millennia, until recently it began to awaken. At first they attempted to appease it with gold and other treasures, but it always returned, wanting more. Eventually they came to the conclusion that they required a human sacrifice to calm the angry beast, and so they used Jay to fulfill this requirement.

Now, the Keepers are regretful, realizing that they have been sacrificing to a false deity. Now the ninja need their help finding Jay, and ask them to chart a map of the island so that they may locate any spots where someone might be hiding a fake monster.

They discover a cave on the other side of the island that is apparently abandoned, and head there immediately. They get there just in time to find Jay being attacked by men in prison uniforms, who are standing next to the faux Wojira they meet earlier.

The heroes fend off the escaped prisoners, when suddenly, Ronin appears, and reveals that he has been taking advantage of his job to track down the escaped convicts, and was now using them to get gold and riches from the Keepers, pretending to be the mythical Wojira.

He attempts to escape on the faux Wojira he created, but he is stopped by Twitchy Tim, who crashes into the fake monster, causing it to sink into the sea. The heroes apprehend Ronin, and throw him and the other crooks into one of the Keepers prisons.

They return to the alter of the Storm Amulet, where the Keepers chief apologizes for what they all did to them. As he prepares to thank them for stopping Ronin, he realizes that the amulet is missing from its perch.

The ninja quickly find Clutch Powers at the shore of the island holding the amulet for himself, and they stop him before he can get away.

The Virtues of Spinjitzu

The Virtues of Spinjitzu[]

Curiosity[]

Zane entered the courtyard a little later than the rest of the ninja after Wu was shocked to see a giant hole in the middle of the wall. Wu asked Jay, Kai, and Nya what the six Fundamental Virtues of Spinjitzu, but they didn't know. Wu then asked Zane, but Zane said he had to take portions of his memory offline in order to defrag them.

With the ninja forgetting the virtues, Wu ordered them to medidate immediately. While medidating, Zane caught a cookie that was thrown into the air by Jay. While Wu was attending to the door, Zane continued to medidate even when Nya heard a roar in the background. When Nya investigated by opening the door, they was shocked to see Wu grasped by a green dragon. The ninja tried to fight the dragon, but the dragon was able to deflect their attacks and escape through a portal. The ninja then entered the portal hoping to save their master.

Balance[]

The ninja exited the portal and saw the green dragon across a pool of lava. Watching Jay and Lloyd attempting to cross the lava, the rest of the ninja are ambuhsed by the Pyro Whippers. After defeating a couple of soldiers, he attempted to cross, but Jay fell from the ceiling and nearly knocked him over. Fortuantely, he is saved by the Fire Dragon and entered the next portal.

Wisdom[]

Zane and the ninja raced in the Speedway Five-Billion attempting to reach the portal at the finish line. However, the Whack Rats were blocking their way and kept respawning every time they were defeated. Lloyd then realized they needed to be defeated in order to get across and after he "died", he respawned near the portal. The rest of the ninja followed suit and entered the next portal.

Honesty[]

Zane and the ninja were trapped in a cage and watched as Kai and Jay jousted in order to earn their freedom. After Jay told the truth of falling in his win, the Ice Emperor was pleased Jay told the truth and freed the rest of the ninja. The Ice Emperor then opened the next portal for the ninja to find Wu.

Generosity[]

Zane and the ninja fought the Awakened Warriors in the Mines of Shintaro. While fighting, Zane saw the Geckles helping out the ninja by launching boulders at the skeletons. However, the lever to the catapult broke, so Zane ran to the Geckles. He was greeted with pebbles being thrown at him and when he asked if the Geckles had any spare levers, Gulch told Zane they were all destroyed in a Lever Bonfire Festival. Realizing his arm could act as a lever, Zane took off his arm and attached it to the catapult. The Geckles were able to use their catapult as they fired at the remaining warriors. Now in the clear, the ninja were about to run to the portal, but Zane caught sight of the Awakened Warriors surrounding the Geckles. Zane convinced the ninja to protect the Geckles which they do. After saving the Geckles from the warriors, the ninja used the catapult to launch themselves to the next portal.

Courage[]

Zane and the ninja found themselves on the Island of the Keepers with Zane commenting on how his arm was restored after sacrificing it to the Geckles. They discovered Wu held captive by the Legendary Dragon along with three other dragons surrounded by a forcefield. As a strategy, Zane suggested they can win over the dragons instead of fighting them, but Kai disregarded all of the strategies suggested by the ninja and took the dragons head on. Kai destroyed the forcefield allowing Cole and Zane to defeat one of the smaller dragons. Despite the ninja defeating the dragons and saving Wu, their master informed them it was merely a lesson to teach the six Fundamental Virtues of Spinjitzu.

Seabound

Seabound[]

A Big Splash[]

Zane and the other ninja are defending a farm village somewhere in Ninjago from a villain that calls herself Miss Demeanor. Demeanor and her henchmen ride three trucks filled with Vengestone through the fields, being apprehended by the Ninja. Zane and Nya run along a ledge to stop her, and the two of them coordinate an attack using their Elemental Powers. Suddenly, Nya's powers go out of control, and a large water tornado starts enveloping the land beyond Nya's will. Miss Demeanor escapes, and the ninja are suddenly forced to protect the nearby village from the out of control vortex.

Zane attempts to hold the vortex with his ice, but the attempt is futile, and so he and the rest of the ninja prepare to evacuate the village. Zane takes a young villager to a save distance, as the entire village is flooded, and the vortex is dispelled. The ninja stand in shock at what just happened.

Later, at the Monastery of Spinjitzu, five of the Ninja, excluding Nya, relay the information they just gathered to Master Wu. They tell him that Demeanor was carrying a large shipment of vengestone, but for what reason they do not know. He tells him that the plan to stop Demeanor was a failure because of an accident involving Nya's powers. Nya suddenly enters the room and frantically explains that what happened back there with the water was a temporary accident and minor mistake on her part. She doesn't know why it happened, but she tries to convince the others that it isn't a big deal. As she says this, the sprinklers go off, presumably because of her.

Master Wu takes the ninja to the Monastery library, where he reveals a scroll listing every Elemental Power. On that list there is no mention of Water nor Wind. Wu reveals that his father, the First Spinjitzu Master, used to tell him stories of how he mastered the Elemental Powers, but never water or wind. This is because they were not his to command, and belonged to someone else: Wojira. Zane puts it together that Wojira was the same of the storm spirit that was worshiped by the Keepers on their island.

Wu tells the ninja that Wojira commanded the powers of Water and Wind, and when combined became the ultimate force of destruction. Long ago, the First Spinjitzu Master conquered Wojira with the help of the Merlopians, sea folk who lived in Ninjago before the First Spinjitzu Master. In the midst of the battle, a Merlopian warrior with a helmet and a trident fought Wojira, and pried from the serpents head two amulets, the Storm Amulet and the Wave Amulet. When Wojira was defeated, the seas calmed, and the beast went into an eternal slumber.

The ninja recall that the Storm Amulet was being protected by the Keepers back on their island, and put it together that Nya's powers might be linked to this mighty serpent. Wu suggests that they enlist the help of Maya, Kai and Nya's mother, in order to try and help understand the problems Nya is facing with her powers. Kai recalls that Nya might not want her help, since she has been absent all of Nya's life, she has become fairly independent.

Later on, after Kai had discussed meeting their mother, Nya storms off into the Monastery and wrecks havoc on the water inside, causing Zane to get soaked while doing the dishes.

Nya returns to the courtyard and is followed by Zane and the others when there is a knock on the main door. On the other end is Nya's parents Ray and Maya, who have come at the request of Kai to help Nya with her powers.

The Call of the Deep[]

After Ray and Maya settle in at the Spinjitzu Monastery, Zane and P.I.X.A.L. go off on a mission, and specifically refrain from mentioning this to Nya, because it was a water rescue, and seeing as Nya has been having trouble controlling her water powers, this might not have been the best idea.

Zane in his Shuricopter and P.I.X.A.L. in her Samurai-X Mech approach a ship in need of rescue in the middle of the Endless Sea. The two of them feel bad for excluding Nya, but because of her current state it's likely that she would only cause more harm.

The two of them apprehend a ship that is being attacked by a large octopus. Zane expresses his confusion about the situation, as octopuses are usually peaceful creatures who live on the bottom of the sea and seldom return to the surface. P.I.X.A.L. attempts to calm it down, as something has clearly agitated it. While Zane rescues the sailors, P.I.X.A.L. is suddenly grabbed by the creature and pulled into the sea.

As she is continually pulled deeper into the ocean, a strange purple energy pulse is released from the ocean. As it envelopes P.I.X.A.L., her mech malfunctions, and she is plunged deeper into the ocean with no way out. Zane sends down a hook line to help her, but it is no use, and he instead tells her to reboot the primary ignition of the mech. She does this, and returns to the surface, now with the creature nowhere to be found.

With the two of them reunited, they express their concern about the energy pulse. Zane looks into his diagnostics and discovers its origin at the bottom of a trench in the Endless Sea. They realize that the pulse not only affected that creature, but also likely Nya's powers. The two of them return to the Monastery to warn the others.

They arrive back at the Monastery to find the others cleaning up the messes that Nya has caused because of her power malfunctions. P.I.X.A.L. reassures Nya that these fluctuations in her powers are not her fault, and are likely being caused by an energy signal from back out at sea. She reveals that the pulse originates from the bottom of the Tartarus Trench, the deepest known point in the ocean. The ninja make the decision to venture deep below the sea to explore this unknown energy signal in the submarine that P.I.X.A.L. has developed that she calls the Hydro Bounty.

Unsinkable[]

P.I.X.A.L. takes the ninja and Wu to the Ninjago City Docks and unveils to them the Hydro Bounty, which has been in development for the past several years. Nya is worried about how positive they are that the underwater pulse they saw was actually related to her power malfunctions, but Zane reassures her that he is about 97% sure. She debates whether or not she should sit this mission out, but she is eventually convinced to go.

The ninja return to the Monastery to pack, while Wu, Kai, and Cole stay behind to watch over Ninjago City, Zane joins P.I.X.A.L., Jay, and Nya as they board the Hydro Bounty.

Zane, having downloaded thousands of hours of pirate movies, begins shouting sailor gibberish to the others, who become increasingly annoyed with him as it goes on. Before they take off, P.I.X.A.L. runs a diagnostic on the ship and discovers movement in the cargo area, but deduces that it's probably some sort of malfunction, and ignores it.

Eventually, they reach the open sea, and a few hours later come across the Tartarus Trench, the deepest and darkest part of the ocean that also happens to be unmapped. The three ninja leave the brig to hang out below deck, and meet each other in the hallway (they also discover that Zane has begun walking as though he has a peg-leg.) The three of them discuss the fact that all of the chores around the Bounty are mysteriously getting done without their knowledge, and they speculate as to what may be causing this. They search the halls and discover that it was Maya, Nya's mother, all along. She tagged along in order to be there for her daughter, but Nya is insulted and takes this as her mother wanting to baby her.

P.I.X.A.L.'s voice rings out over the intercom and tells the others to return to the brig. They soon come to find that they are entering what looks to be a graveyard of sunken ships, when suddenly they are attacked by something underwater. They try their best to defend themselves, but the Hydro Bounty takes critical damage, and is forced to land on a nearby rock formation, now totally defenseless with no way out.

Five Thousand Fathoms Down[]

Zane and the others are stranded at the bottom of the sea, and tensions are high. Zane, Jay, and Lloyd eavesdrop while Nya and Maya squabble in the engine room attempting to find the source of their problems, and quickly try to act auspicious when Nya catches them listening. She tells them that the engines are shot, and the only way to get back is to use some sort of power source. Jay suggests they use his lightning, but this would be extremely dangerous, as Zane brings up he was once hooked up to a machine like that, and it almost proved fatal (remembering the time The Mechanic used him to power the gateway into Prime Empire.)

Maya suggests they find the energy pulse in the sea to power the ship, and the ninja agree this is the only option. P.I.X.A.L. brings the group to the cargo bay where she has two underwater mechs there waiting for them. Nya and Maya board one each, and Maya promises to help Nya if any more problems with her powers occur, seeing as she was the previous Master of Water.

The two of them take off, being guided by Zane and the others through a body cam and mic as they traverse the endless oceans. The two of them dodge hydro-thermal vents, and eventually find their way to the source of the energy signal, which appears to be behind a large underwater temple. They enter and discover an air pocket. In the underwater cave they discover a large stone door with ancient Ninjargan text on it, that Zane predicts predates the First Spinjitzu Master. He translates it and reveals that it is a warning telling of the "sleeper of the deep," who shall only be awoken during the end of days. Nya and Maya enter the stone door while Zane sits back to try and translate the name of this mysterious sleeper.

Moments later, he suddenly wakes up and reveals to them the name on the warning: Wojira. It is too late, as Nya and Maya have stumbled into a large chamber where Wojira herself is being experimented on by a race of sea people. These people are attempting to awaken Wojira, and it is revealed that their experiments are what's causing the energy signals. One of these signals is shot out again and hits Nya point-blank, causing her to glow, which alerts the attention of the creature's leader. They begin to attack the mother and daughter duo, who attempt to make their escape.

Zane and the others watch through the cams as the sea creatures seize Maya and Nya, and their leader boasts that he has been waiting for the Master of Water for a long time, the usurper, who will help him become the ruler of the Endless Sea.

The Wrath of Kalmaar[]

Zane, Jay, Lloyd, and P.I.X.A.L. remain sitting ducks at the bottom of the Tartarus Trench. P.I.X.A.L. estimates they only have one hour before their oxygen runs out. With the power still off, and with no way to save Nya, Jay suggests that he use his powers to recharge the battery, however Zane warns him that this effort could prove to be fatal.

Their next attempt to bring the power back is to try to reroute all existing power back to the hull, but this proves to be futile. Their situation becomes worse as water begins flooding the lower decks, and Jay leaves the group in order to retrieve "oxygen tanks." The others quickly realize that that is not what he meant, and go down to the lower deck to find Jay locked in a room flooded with water attempting to recharge the battery. He uses his powers, and the attempt is a success, causing the lights to turn back on and the water level to lower.

Zane and the others worry that Jay has been hurt, but he opens the door to reveal that he is fine.

The four of them return to the brig where they finally take off, and Jay vows to save Nya.

Long Live the King[]

Zane and the others delve deeper into the trench and are able to save Nya and Maya from being attacked by sharks just in time. With the group reunited, they return to the Hydro Bounty, only to be apprehended by Merlopian guards, who arrest them for trespassing in their kingdom.

Zane and the others are brought before King Trimaar of the Merlopians, are are accused of trespassing in their kingdom. Nya explains that they had no idea this kingdom even existed, but they also had no choice seeing as their ship was shot down by Kalmaar, the King's son. She further explains that Kalmaar tied them up, and he is attempting to awaken Wojira the storm spirit.

Kalmaar enters the throne room and does not deny these accusations. He goes on to berrate his father for not taking action against the surface dwellers, who stole the Endless Sea from them when they arrived thousands of years ago. Trimaar is content that Ninjago is at peace, but Kalmaar is not, and stages an insurrection, murdering his father in front of the ninja and blaming it directly on them.

Zane and the others are forced to flee from the guards, and make their way through the palace. While they make their escape, the palace halls are flooded, causing them all to put on their scuba masks. Zane puts one on, even though he doesn't need to, because it completes his look.

More sharks are sent to attack them, and Zane creates an ice wall in front of them to block them from the attack. The ninja attempt to open a door out of there while the sharks break through the ice...

Escape from Merlopia[]

The sharks manage to break through the ice, but they are sent away by Benthomaar, the late King's adopted son. He helps them escape from Merlopia by bypassing the guards and breaking into the hangar bay to retrieve the Hydro Bounty. Zane and the others fend off several Ma Array Guards while they make their way to the bounty. They are able to escape, with Lloyd hanging on to the back of the ship inside a mech, but are continuously pursued by Kalmaar and his troops.

The chase is on in the dark depths of the Endless Sea, and as the Hydro Bounty dodges missile attacks, Kalmaar is accidentally destroying the Merlopian city nearby. The ninja eventually see a cave where they are able to make their escape, and deploy three Master Wu shaped bombs to block the exit off as they go.

Now finally in the clear, Nya introduces the team to Benthomaar, and he tells the group that Kalmaar wants to awaken the sleeping Wojira, and their father told him to do everything in his power to stop them. Nya reassures him that the only way to awaken Wojira is with the second amulet, and they know where it is. P.I.X.A.L. sets a course for the Island of the Keepers.

The Tale of Benthomaar[]

Benthomaar details the story of how he was adopted to the Ninja. He tells them that several years ago, when he was just a young boy, he was found by Trimaar and Kalmaar getting attacked by eels. He has no memories from before this moment, and he doesn't even know who his real parents are. In that moment, Trimaar defended him, and adopted him as his own.

In the coming years, Trimaar would treat Bentho as his own, training him to become a fantastic athlete and loving him as a son. All these years, however, Benthomaar tried all his might to be noticed and appreciated by Kalmaar. Kalmaar spent their entire childhood obsessed with ancient scrolls and texts detailing an ancient mythical creature, and resented Benthomaar, as he saw him as a sign of his father's weakness.

One day, not too long ago, Kalmaar discovered the well-kept secret of a temple that exists at the bottom of the Tartarus Trench. He confronted his father about this, but was sent off, as the trench is too dangerous for any one man to journey alone. Kalmaar ignored his father's warning, and decided that he would manipulate his adopted brother to make the trek in his stead.

He met with his brother, and swayed him with words of encouragement and praise, which Bentho had never heard from Kalmaar before. Wanting to finally spend time with his brother, the two of them set off to the Tartarus Trench, where Kalmaar made sure Bentho set off the traps on the way there in order to protect himself. When the two of them finally reached the Temple of Wojira, Kalmaar sent Benthomaar off, saying that the two of them will never be brothers. Heartbroke, Benthomaar returned home, finally realizing that Kalmaar is too stubborn, and he will never love him as a brother.

As Benthomaar finishes telling this story to the Ninja, he tells them that King Trimaar was the only one who loved him, and now he is gone. The ninja reassure him that they appreciate him, and together they're going to stop Kalmaar from awakening Wojira.

The Storm Amulet[]

Zane, Jay, and Maya listen in while Benthomaar describes the situation with Wojira. In the serpents head are two holes, one of them currently being occupied by the Wave Amulet, and the other empty in wait for the Storm Amulet. If both amulets were to be returned to her, then she will be awakened, and destroy Ninjago.

As his explanation concludes, P.I.X.A.L. calls the ninja to the upper deck, where they find that they have finally returned to the Island of the Keepers. They meet with Chief Mammatus and explain to him their situation, and he agrees to lend them the Storm Amulet to protect it from Kalmaar. He grants Nya the guardian of the amulet, as the First Spinjitzu Master did thousands of years ago to his ancestors. She accepts the job, but Zane notices something odd about the amulet. A piece chips off, and he comes to the conclusion that the real Storm Amulet was taken by Clutch Powers and is currently at the Explorer's Club in Ninjago City.

The team heads back to the Bounty where they radio in Cole, who they tell of the situation. The group is suddenly attacked by Kalmaar and his troupes, who heard everything. Instead of killing them, he destroys their ship, leaving them hopeless and defeated. He leaves, briefly followed by Nya, who eventually returns to the Bounty, unable to breath underwater.

Nya is hopeless and depressed, but her mother Maya helps her see the bright side, and reassures her that she's confident that she will find a way off this Island.

Riddle of the Sphinx[]

Zane returns to the brig of the Hydro Bounty to see if any of the machinery is salvageable, but soon comes to the conclusion that is is unable to be saved. He meets the others on the upper deck to tell them that all hope is lost.

Benthomaar suggests that Nya just call over a whale to pull their ship, but she says that isn't in the wheelhouse of her powers. Benthomaar disagrees, as she is the Master of Water. Nya is confused, and Maya explains that Nyad, the First Master of Water, was able to not only control water, but all sea creatures.

Nya steps into the ocean and gives it her best shot, and eventually several whales appear to their aid, and the heroes regain hope. Their next stop is Ninjago City.

Master of the Sea[]

Benthomaar goes into detail about the story of Nyad and Wojira.

Thousands of years ago, the First Spinjitzu Master discovered the world in a chaotic state, ruled by Wojira. He knew that life could not prosper in this world of storms, so he teamed up with the Merlopians and the Keepers in order to cease the calamity. Wojira was too powerful for them, and so a Merlopian warrior, Nyad the First Master of Water rose up and took on the challenge. She realized that the only way to defeat Wojira was to unlock her ultimate power and become the sea itself, meaning she gave up her physical form in order to finally defeat the serpent, sacrificing herself.

The First Spinjitzu Master was able to pry the Storm and Wave Amulets out of the beast's head, causing it to enter a deep slumber, and he entrusted the Storm Amulet to the Keepers, and the Wave Amulet to the Merlopians. Following this, he was able to create Ninjago.

Benthomaar finishes his story and the ninja reassure him that they will stop Kalmaar, whatever it takes.

Some time later, they arrive back in Ninjago, just in time to aid Kai, Cole, and Wu in fighting Kalmaar for the Storm Amulet on the surface. They battle it out, but Kalmaar seemingly gets away. Nya briefly catches up to him and gets close enough to apparently steal the Storm Amulet back from him.

The ninja rejoice and return to the Monastery. They give Benthomaar a tour of the temple, and invite him to stay with them for a while. Ray and Maya are also getting ready to leave, and they say their goodbyes as well. Benthomaar asks Zane and Jay where the Storm Amulet is currently being kept, and they reveal that it was sent to the Kingdom of Shintaro for safe keeping... unaware that the real Storm Amulet still resides with Kalmaar, and they only retrieved a fake...


The Calm Before the Storm[]

Zane, Nya, Jay, Benthomaar, and Wu are called to the police station, some days after apparently winning the battle against Kalmaar. There they find Glutinous, who has come to warn them that Kalmaar has successfully awakened Wojira two days ago, and is on his way to Ninjago City right now.

He tells them he had a change of thought after she was awakened, and felt that he had to warn them.

Wu realizes the crisis they are in and calls for an emergency evacuation of the city, and for P.I.X.A.L. to finish working on the undersea subs she has been developing.

The evacuation is sent into order, as Wojira rises out of the sea with Kalmaar at her forehead, and the city is flooded.

Assault on Ninjago City[]

Zane, Kai, and Benthomaar are sent out into the flood to help save civilians, while also fending off Merlopian warriors. Cole returns from Shintaro to help out, and the four of them assist Lloyd in saving as many people as they can.
