Wojira eventually makes contact with Ninjago, as it wrecks calamity throughout the water ridden city. Zane and the others make their way to the Bounty, which has been sea bound because of an attack. They fend off Wojira as best they can, when Nya finally arrives to help.

Nyad[]

Zane and the others continue to defend the city as best they can from Wojira and Kalmaar, but they are too powerful. Why Nya fends them off, they are approached by Merlopian guards, and are forced to retreat. They make their rounds around the city and discover Jay has crashed and is about to suffocate underwater. Benthomaar helps him out, but he falls unconscious before he can reach the surface.

They bring him back to the Bounty, when Wu tells P.I.X.A.L. to put it on autopilot. The group and the refugees hide inside a nearby building, letting the Bounty off as bait. They lay Jay down, when Nya walks in, and they tell her that he is not in good condition, as he has a lot of ocean water in his lungs.

The ninja are somber as the sea continues to rise and Kalmaar is in search of them. Zane is asleep with the others, when he is awoken to find Nya rush out of the room. Benthomaar tells them that she plans on becoming one with the sea, like Nyad before her, sacrificing herself to destroy Wojira.

Zane and the others rush outside to stop her, but they are too late, and Nya becomes one with her Elemental Power, now an ultimate master of water. She goes after Wojira and begins to attack.

The Turn of the Tide[]

Zane and the others climb to the top of a building to watch as Nya fends of King Kalmaar and Wojira. She is holding her own, now made of water itself, Kalmaar can't penetrate her body. He is able to electrocute her, causing her to dissipate into midair. Jay is infuriated and goes in to attack, and when he is unable to stop him, Benthomaar also takes his hand at fighting with his adopted brother.

Neither of them can defeat him, but after Wojira ate Kalmaar whole, Nya suddenly returns, now in the form of a large water dragon, and battles Wojira and in the process destroys the Wave Amulet.

After Wojira was defeated, the ninja rejoice, as they have finally won, and tell Nya that they will find a way to return her to normal, however she does not want to. The sea calls to her, and she is calm. The ninja try to stop her from leaving, imploring that she fight the call to the sea, but she is intent on departing. She says her final goodbyes, and Jay says he loves her for the last time, and she takes off into the sea, with the water level finally lowering.

Some time later, Zane and the other ninja hold a memorial for her at the Monastery. All of their friends and family come to pay their respects to Nya, and in memory of her, the five remaining ninja and P.I.X.A.L. pour water out into a vase as they say their final words.

After Seabound

After Seabound[]

Tentacles Below![]

A few days after the Great Flood, Zane and the other ninja responded to reports of a monster dwelling in the sewers of Ninjago City. After temporarily dealing with the creatures' tentacles, the ninja descended deeper into the sewers to investigate. After a moment of walking through the dank and putrid waters, Zane was the first to discovering the identity of the creature: it was a baby leviathan. After several failed attempts by the other ninja in attacking the creature, Zane realized that just like the adult leviathan he freed from Lighthouse Island many years ago, this baby had no desire to attack Ninjago City; it simply wanted to escape and return home. After Lloyd proposed a few poor ideas for moving the baby, Cole thought up of an alternative plan: Zane would freeze some of the sewer water and Kai would melt it to create a flow of water! Agreeing that Cole's idea was the best, Zane played his part and things worked like a charm! Eventually, the ninja transported the baby to around Lighthouse Island where it would be reunited with its parent - the very same leviathan Zane had freed years ago! Zane then explained to the adult leviathan the ninja's intentions with its baby, and the adult responded by lifting all of them out from the sewers, setting the ninja down safely on Lighthouse Island. As the leviathans waved their tentacles in goodbye, Zane waved back and joined the others into the lighthouse in search of a radio to contact P.I.X.A.L. with.

Back to Merlopia![]

One day, following a visit to the Monastery by Glutinous, Zane and the other ninja learned of Gripe's return to Merlopia and his intentions of seizing the throne in Benthomaar's absence. After some preparations, the ninja set out to Merlopia to stop Gripe's attempted coup. After diving into the waters surrounding Merlopia with their APS suits, the ninja briefly fought against one of Gripe's patrols before making their way to the palace itself.

After sneaking into the palace through one of the supply hatches, Zane and the others encountered Gripe and his forces. After a brief skirmish with the Maaray Soldiers, Gripe and forces began retreating towards the palace. The ninja gave chase and attempted to intercept their foes by traveling through one of the lower tunnels, but unfortunately, Gripe had anticipated for the ninja to take such action and ordered for the lower tunnel to be flooded. As the tunnel filled with water, Zane assisted Jay and Lloyd in attempting to pry open the tunnel doors, but they were all rescued thanks to the intervention of Glutinous. After recovering from this experience, the ninja hastily rushed towards the throne room to confront Gripe and his forces.

In response to seeing the ninja and their survival, Gripe and his followers simply responded by locking themselves inside the throne room, leaving the ninja without anyway inside, a fact confirmed by Zane. He then watched as Kai lost his temper and began a brazen attack against the throne room door, tearing it apart and single handedly defeating Gripe and his forces. After Kai proclaimed victory, Zane and the other ninja expressed that they were impressed with Kai's single handed victory and departed from Merlopia after Gripe was handed over to Glutinous' custody.

Great Droids Think Alike[]

Sometime after thwarting Gripe's coup, Zane and P.I.X.A.L. worked on upgrades to the former's Power Up Mech. With the help of the Shuricopter, the pair towed the mech to the coastline to test its performance in the water. As Zane suited up, P.I.X.A.L. explained that as a nindroid, Zane had the ability to connect his mind with the mech and control it as if he were controlling his own body. After establishing the necessary connection, Zane exclaimed that things were working exactly as P.I.X.A.L. had described, and he was amazed about the mech's ease of control. However, he did note that the mech felt sluggish in water, to which P.I.X.A.L. noted as well and flew back to the Monastery to retrieve additional parts.

While Zane continued to practice with the mech, he remained unaware that Gripe and his forces were not too far away and were spying on the Ninja of Ice. Believing that the Power Up Mech could be reverse-engineered to develop new war machines for his next coup attempt, Gripe ordered his followers to capture Zane. As the three Maaray Soldiers attacked Zane and began climbing atop his mech, Zane slammed the mech's chest and forcibly ejected himself and everyone attached to him. In this process however, Zane also unwittingly transferred his consciousness entirely into the mech, leaving his body behind as an empty husk! When Gripe and his forces reconvened and deemed the Power Up Mech as being 'too dangerous,' they decided instead to take Zane's lifeless body with them, believing that the blueprints to the mech were stored inside. As all these matters went on, Zane watched from inside his new mech body, completely unable to do anything to stop Gripe and his soldiers.

Not long after, P.I.X.A.L. returned with the additional armor pieces, only to discover to her shock that Zane was gone. Before she could scramble too far, however, Zane revealed his presence inside the Power Up Mech and explained the situation. Nonplussed, P.I.X.A.L. deemed that this would be a perfect opportunity to test out the mech's full capabilities, for Zane would be able to control it now as if it were his own body. Although initially skeptical, Zane admitted that he had not even tried to move his new mech body yet and discovered to his surprise that he could! Zane and P.I.X.A.L. then began giving chase to Gripe and his forces, intent on recovering the former's regular body. Although Zane would be briefly slowed down by the Maaray Soldiers' cannon fire (he could also feel the pain inflicted upon his new mech body), this problem would be alleviated thanks to additional armoring that P.I.X.A.L. had packed for the mech.

Even with these upgrades however, the Power Up Mech was not fast enough, nor was it equipped with any tools or weaponry, to stop the Maaray Soldiers' craft. Undeterred, P.I.X.A.L. quickly attached one of the Shuricopter's sawblades onto the Power Up Mech and flew Zane over to the craft. Armed with his new saw, Zane sheared apart the Maaray craft and defeated Gripe and his forces, sending all of the craft's occupants flying out into the air in the process. After P.I.X.A.L. successfully caught Zane's body, she reconnected him to the mech and transfered his consciousness back into his body. Once things returned to normal, Zane expressed his relief as P.I.X.A.L. helped him to his feet.

Bad Water![]

One day at the Monastery, the ninja discovered that their water supply had been contaminated. Zane tested the well and confirmed that the water inside contained heavy amounts of chemicals, prompting the ninja to journey to Ninjago City to investigate further, for the Monastery drew its water from the same source as the city. It wouldn't take long, however, for the ninja to discover that all of the city's water supply had been contaminated. While the other four ninja decided to journey upstream to investigate further, Zane chose to return to the Monastery to make sure that Wu did not brew anymore tea with the tainted water.

Separate Ways[]

Zane brought in the Destiny's Bounty to a nature preserve after being called in by Cole. Zane then assisted in helping the citizens relocate out of the nature preserve and oversaw the continued operation alongside Kai while Cole left to accompany Jay on another mission.

Crystalized

Crystalized[]

Farewell the Sea[]

It has been one year since Nya's disappearance, and Zane, Cole, and P.I.X.A.l. are the only ninja who remain at the monastery. Zane has turned his emotion meter off so as not to have any unwanted emotions and increase productivity.

Him and Cole see on the news that the new mayor has hired a group of New Ninja to help track down the copious amounts of Vengestone being stolen. Realizing that this is going to be an issue, the two of them attempt to get the team back together.

They first track down Kai, who is now a Master at his own dojo teaching children. He teaches them that the best defense is to obliterate your enemy before they see you coming. Zane and Cole succeed in recruiting Kai back, and move on to find Lloyd.

In Ninjago City, Lloyd is working on cleaning windows. Lloyd is still depressed over Nya's sacrifice, and wants to be left alone. Zane, Cole, and Kai leave him for now, hoping to have better luck with Jay.

They take the Destiny's Bounty to the Lighthouse Island to find that Jay has become a recluse. He has grown a full beard, is obsessed with painting Nya, and believes that he can "talk" to Nya through half-empty water glasses that litter the lighthouse. They try to reason with him, but Jay is reluctant to rejoin the team. He is swayed after he sees the enormous outpouring of love from Ninjago City citizens for Nya.

The four of them leave the Lighthouse and meet up with Lloyd and make the decision to root out the mystery of these Vengestone shipments together, for Nya.

The Shape of Nya[]

At the Monastery, the five ninja discuss how the Vengestone is being moved. It can't be transported from the air or underground, so they're at a loss. Jay pipes in and realizes that it can be transported from underground, if it's moved through Ninjago's discontinued N-Line.

They make their way there, and they put it together that the city stopped building this tunnel, but it's possible that "someone else" did. They find a bricked off wall and wonder if it's possible that there's some hidden mechanism that opens it, but Zane scans it and disproves this theory. They suddenly hear rustling from behind them and find a whole cart of Vengestone inside it, and an old man with a clipboard. The old man presumes that they're the ones that are there to purchase it and asks for their signature.

Suddenly, the group is attacked by Miss Demeanor and her thugs. The ninja are unable to use their powers, as the Vengestone nearby them prohibits it.

The ninja result in having to use their weapons to fight low level thugs, but their lack of practice wears them out, and their fight is interrupted by the group of New Ninja, who easily wipe the floor with the thugs.

Humiliated, the ninja leave the fight to them and watch as they get the recognition for their arrests. They thank the New ninja begrudgingly, and realize how different they are from this new group.

Back at the Monastery, the ninja are upset about the fact that they're replaced, except for Zane. Zane isn't reacting emotionally to this situation, after turning off his emotion meter. In a fit of anger, Jay and Kai start fighting with each other, which Zane attempts to stop. Suddenly, Nya returns to them in her water form, but she is unstable. She pleads for their help, saying that there's some way for her to be normal. She says that if they can drain her power before she loses her shape they can help her. Zane freezes her in her current state before she can fade away.

Contemplating what she just said, they realize that if they drain Nya's powers in the same way that Aspheera once drained Kai's powers, she may be able to be saved. It's a tough decision, but the team comes together once again, and unanimously decides to break Aspheera out of prison to save Nya.

A Mayor Problem[]

Zane stays behind keeping Nya frozen, while the other ninja go to Mayor Trustable's office to ask for his assistance in getting Aspheera out of prison. They plead their cases, but he refuses to let them break her out for the sake of Nya.

The four of them return and decide that the only way to save Nya without the mayor's help is to break her out of prison illegally. Lloyd devises a plan to break Aspheera out of Kryparium and steal her staff from Borg Tower. He decides that Kai, Zane, and him will go to Kryptarium to break her out, while the others go for the staff.

Zane is hesitant, as he is needed at the Monastery to help keep Nya frozen, but Lloyd already has that covered. Skylor comes in and says she's there to use Zane's power to keep Nya cool. Now Zane can come with them to help them past Kryptarium's new thermal-sensor security equipment.

Zane, Kai, and Lloyd break into Kryptarium Prison wearing neutral colors so as not to be spotted. In order to get by the thermal sensors, Zane freezes the other two ninja solid and carries them across the hall. After they unthaw, Zane lifts up a hatch in the floor that leads directly to Cell One, where Aspheera is being contained.

They lower themselves to her and coherce her to come help them. They break her out and hurry back the way they came, but Zane's laser pointer is knocked out of his hand, and the rope holding the cell together is severed, alerting all the guards.

The four of them are forced to make a daring escape, now on the run from the cops.

Public Enemies 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5![]

Zane and the others finally arrive at the Monastery, just as Skylor is about to lose access to her power over Ice. Zane re-cools Nya to keep her shape, and tells P.I.X.A.L. and Skylor that Kai and Lloyd are showing Aspheera around the Monastery.

She is brought to their secret base and inform her of the situation, but she is unfortunately unable to help Nya without her staff. Cole and Jay then arrive empty handed, saying that the staff was moved from its vault under Borg Tower. They call Cyrus Borg, and he informs them that the staff is a part of a guarded convoy through the city. Zane analyzes the best place to intercept the armored vehicles.

P.I.X.A.L. prepares the five ninja new vehicles in a short matter of time in order to pass by undetected. They enter the roads on their new treads, once again wearing neutral colors, and promise each other not to use their names or their powers.

Zane uses his new jet to track the guarded convoy, and the five of them intercept the truck with the staff in it. Zane uses a grappeling hook to magnetize the jet to one of the trucks, turning it airborn. Zane flies the jet, which is propelling the truck in the air, while the other four ninja enter inside to take the staff.

There are complications, as the New ninja are inside of it, having been waiting for their arrival. The two groups of ninja fight each other, and the Teal Ninja throws an explosive at Zane's jet, which causes them to lose altitude.

The truck crashes on top of a building, and the ninja detatch it from the jet to make a quick getaway. They have also been unmasked, which makes them figitives on the run.

A Painful Promise[]

The five of them return to the Monastery, once again just in time to freeze Nya in place once again. Lloyd returns Aspheera's staff to her, but she turns her back on them and starts attacking. She starts screaming for revenge and shoots them all at random. The police and the New ninja suddenly show up, ordering them to come with them, as they are under arrest.

They convince Aspheera to save Nya while they fight off the police off, and promise her a way out of the Monastery so that she won't get caught. This plan works, and Nya finally returns to normal. Everyone is knocked out, and Jay and Nya embrace each other finally. Lloyd leads Aspheera out of the Monastery, where she escapes.

Now the ninja are finally under arrest, and they go peacefully.

Ninjago City vs. Ninja[]

The ninja are brought to court before a judge, with Dareth as their lawyer. Their trial goes by extremely fast, and the ninja are convicted to five years in prison for their crimes.

The five of them are shoved into their cells, and Lloyd recommends that they sit in there and wait for Dareth to find them a way out legally, rather than break themselves out. During yard time, all the other prisoners stare at them. They are approached by Ronin, who is still vengeful after they locked him up for what he did on the Island of the Keepers. Tensions are high, but the group are broken up by a guard who tells Lloyd that a visitor is here to see him. He is taken away by a guard, and is gone for quite a while.

After some time, after Zane and the others have returned to their cell, Lloyd is shoved back in in handcuffs. He reveals to them that the visitor was a masked man who told him that an individual known as the Crystal King is assembling a council of the Ninja's greatest enemies in an effort to totally obliterate them. Zane runs "Crystal King" through his databases and finds no matches.

Kryptarium Prison Blues[]

The next day, Dareth and Skylor visit the ninja to inform them that the only way to get them out is to call for a mistrial. Zane informs him that they do not have the grounds for a mistrial. To pack onto the bad news, Skylor informs them that King Vangelis in Shintaro has been broken out of his prison. Lloyd speculates that the Crystal King is behind this. They ask Dareth to investigate, and he tells them he has one last strategy that might work.

Their time for meeting ends and they are brought back to their cells.

Later on during yard time, the ninja meet Pythor, who they haven't seen since the Day of the Departed. Pythor was apparently busted by the New Ninja, and he himself hopes that the Crystal King will recruite him to join his council. Pythor engages a fight with the five of them, and the other prisoners join in. The fight is broken up, and Pythor swears his allegiance to the Crystal King as they are brought back to their cells.

Later in the middle of the night, the ninja are woken up by a group of Crystal Spiders entering Pythor's cell. Pythor is broken out of his cell, and the ninja give chase. The Crystal Spiders carry Pythor out, while officers attempt to stop the ninja from escaping themselves. A helicopter arrives to carry Pythor out, and the ninja aren't quick enough to stop him from escaping. Now sitting ducks, the guards apprehend the ninja and return them to their prison cells.

Hounddog McBrag[]

The ninja are asleep in their cells when they are woken up early for work detail. They board a prison bus along with several other prisoners, including Fugi-Dove, and are driven away. Some time later, the bus is stopped in the middle of the road by an older man who has stopped his car, blocking their passing.

It turns out to be Dareth, stalling the cops to wait for Nya to appear in a new Samurai X mech, who then helps break the ninja out. They get in the car with Dareth, and he reveals that this was his last "strategy" to get them out. He also brought them new ninja suits, compliments from P.I.X.A.L. They also discover Fugi-Dove in the back seat, who followed them.

Meanwhile, the police are giving chase with them. They end up losing them and the car breaks down, which means they can't escape by car anymore. They make the plan to split up so they don't all get caught. Twitchy Tim's gas station is close by, so they make decide to reconvene there. Zane, Kai, and Dareth go one way, while the others go another.

The Benefit of Grief[]

Zane, Kai, and Dareth have been walking for hours, and Zane doesn't break a sweat. The other two are exhausted but spot a van driving on the highway nearby. A young woman named Sally picks them up and gives them a ride. Zane puts on his human disguise so as not to be recognized.

Sally tells them that she's moving to Ninjago City to be a singer, and puts one of her own songs on the speaker for them. Dareth and Kai are moved by the song, but Zane remains emotionless. He doesn't understand that music is supposed to make you feel something. Zane points out a picture of Sally's parents and she breaks down crying. She reveals that she actually ran away from home because she wanted to go to Ninjago City, but her father said she wasn't old enough. She stole her father's van and bruised the bumper. Her story is interrupted by a police helicopter who calls out to them that they are under arrest. Sally misunderstands the situation and thinks her father called the cops on her, and she makes her getaway.

Zane and the others board the van to try to reason with her. Zane deactivates his cloak to show her that they are actually the ones the police are after, but she doesn't listen. In a fit of emotions, Sally rides the car to the edge of a cliff and accidentally falls off the side of it into a river. They are continually pursued by the police, which include Ninjago's top sheriff, Hounddog McBrag.

McBrag follows them into the river and chases them through the rapids. Zane uses his powers to stop him in the middle of the river, and Sally and the others drive away. They finally part at the end of the river, and Sally gets out of the car, ecstatic at the adventure they just had. After their temultuous journey, their car breaks down, and Sally goes into a crying fit. She claims to wish that she could turn off her emotions as well.

Zane sees this and begins to see that having emotions, even upleasant ones, serve a purpose. He reveals this to Sally, and reassures her that her parents will forgive her, despite her worries. They take Sally back to her parent's house and watch as her parents greet her at the door and embrace her, having been worried sick.

Zane turns his emotions back on, having realized that there is a benefit to emotions, even grief. The three of them take off, as Sally looks back at them with a smile.

The Fifth Villain[]

The three of them arrive at Twitchy's shop and are given plenty of water and food. Sometime later, the rest of the ninja arrive after a long and difficult journey. After recuperating, Lloyd devises a plan to infiltrate the Council of the Crystal King by posing as the next villain they recruit. They go over the next candidates, and recall that Vangelis, Aspheera, and Pythor have already been recruited.

That leaves Captain Soto, Killow, and Ultra Violet, but they are only small-time criminals. Kai brings up Krux, Acronix, or Garmaon, but Lloyd reminds him that their wherabouts are currently unknown. Jay then suggests the Mechanic, and so the ninja make the plan to go back to his layer and scope it out.

Unfortunately for them, the police are still hot on their tail, and they are forced to hide in Twitchy's cramped shop. Sheriff McBrag enters the shop with three other cops, and Twitchy accidentally reveals that he's harboring the fugitive Ninja. With their hiding spots compromised, they scramble to escape, and are able to make it out unscathed with the help of Fugi-Dove, who distracts McBrag and the cops.

Later that night the ninja return to the Mechanic's old layer and are met with the man himself. They engage in battle with him, attempting to hold him down, but he uses his mechanical arms to do them in. Eventually he is caught under a Prime Empire arcade cabinet, which gives Lloyd the opportunity to disguise himself as him.

Lloyd, disguised as the Mechanic, waits inside of his layer for Kabuki Mask to appear. Elsewhere, in one of Master Chen's noodle trucks, the other ninja are able to watch Lloyd's location using a tracker that Zane built out of Mechanic's scraps. The Mechanic is tied up next to them as they operate.

It doesn't take long for Lloyd to be approached by the Crystal Spiders, and he is recruited by the Kabuki Mask to join the Council of the Crystal King.

The Council of the Crystal King[]

Zane and the others watch as Lloyd makes his way through the tunnels under Ninjago City. They follow his beacon from above in the city streets until Lloyd stops at the abandoned N-Line they were at earlier. Suddenly, Lloyd's beacon begins moving at ridiculous speeds in one direction, much faster than the maximum velocity of a regular subway train.

They take off as well, in an attempt not to lose him. A fight breaks out in the trunk now that the Mechanic has freed himself, which Cole and Jay barely have under control. Mechanic uses his machines to knock the noodle truck on its side, allowing him to make his escape. The four ninja chase after him into the subway and battle him while trains fly by. The four of them are no match for the Mechanic, as they are still out of practice from their year off. The Mechanic is able to take off on the train, and the ninja attempt to contact Lloyd about the situation at hand. If the real Mechanic shows up, Lloyd will be compromised. Unbeknownst to them, a crystal spider watches and listens in on their conversation about Lloyd's infiltration, and takes off to report it to the council.

The Spider's Design[]

Zane and the other three ninja made their way down towards the N line, having tracked Lloyd's last known location as being within its vicinity. As they investigated, Wu contacted them to inform them of his encounter with McBrag. Shortly after the ninja came across a derelict subway car and Zane watched on as Jay recognized it as a BRTM-12 and began rattling off trivia about it to the others. Shortly after, thanks to Kai's growing impatience, Zane and the others resumed their investigation of the N line.

As the ninja neared the end of the N line, Zane's sensors began picking up a peculiar tapping sound in the surrounding area. Unsure of the source, Zane informed the others to stay on lookout. As he investigated, Cole shouted to the others that a horde of Crystal Spiders were coming their way, forcing all four ninja to run back towards the BRTM-12, with Zane being the first to dive into the decommissioned subway car. After the spiders detonated and the rubble settled, Zane brushed dust off his chest and watched onward as the others celebrated their survival.

The Fall of the Monastery[]

With the initial joy of survival having worn off, Zane and the other ninja began examining their circumstances more closely, with Zane noting that they were buried under a massive amount of rubble. When efforts to clear the rubble failed, Zane remarked that their situation was too precarious to make any further attempts at clearing the rubble and instead offered to amplify their communicators so that they could reach their allies at the Monastery for help.

Mere seconds after successfully reaching the team stationed at the Monastery, the train car's ceiling began to collapse from the weight of the debris, forcing Zane and the others to hastily evacuate through an emergency exit that Zane discovered in the car's floor.

Darkness Within[]

Although Zane and the other ninja managed to barely escape from certain doom, they still remained buried beneath the damaged BRTM-12 in the collapsed subway tunnels. With a groan, Jay asked Zane if the communicator he had borrowed from Kai still worked, though Zane hardly required a glance to tell it was broken beyond repair in their hasty escape. As a rat scurried by, Zane felt a sudden burst of inspiration and informed the others that rats were known as experts in survival. Although Kai interjected with a dismissive comment, Zane ignored him and continued his analysis, noting that the rat had squeezed through the debris and would likely be searching for an exit. Zane then followed suit to test his hypothesis and confirmed the existence of a tunnel seemingly to the surface, prompting the other ninja to follow.

Unfortunately, their ascension was cut short when Jay slipped and shifted the debris around them and sealing the ninja away from the surface once more. As they sat along in their 'cave', Zane suggested that they play a game or share stories to help pass the time until rescue arrived, with Jay offering to sing a folksong about cursed ramen. In spite of Jay's claims that the song was well known, Zane remarked that his databanks contained no information on such a song. To make matters worse, Jay's song was accompanied by a small dance that consequently only served to further disturb the ninja's already unstable position. As a massive piece of asphalt fell atop the ninja, Zane and the others struggled to brace themselves against it, but found their strength quickly slipping away. Just as they were about to accept their fate, the ninja felt the piece of debris grow lighter and turned upwards awe as they glimpsed sunlight for the first time in a while.

With some help from Nya and her new mech, Zane and the others finally stepped into the streets of Ninjago City, out from the subway tunnels. They then learned from her that the Council of the Crystal King had destroyed the Monastery of Spinjitzu and that Harumi had returned from her seeming death all those years ago. Without time to lose, the ninja climbed aboard the mech and flew off to the old Samurai X Cave in the Sea of Sand. After entering the hideout, Zane was quickly embraced by P.I.X.A.L. who worriedly asked if he was hurt, though Zane reassured her that he was not. P.I.X.A.L. then introduced the ninja to MiniPix Seven and Zane shook hands with the small robot while expressing his pleasure at meeting it.

The Coming of the King[]

Zane monitored the central computer of the Samurai X Cave while the other ninja worked on constructing a new vehicle. After the portion Kai and Cole were working on caught fire, one of the monitor's sensors began beeping. When Wu mistook his beeping for the fire alarm, he asked Zane to deactivate it, though Zane affirmed with confusion that it was already deactivated. After Nya stepped in an pulled up the corresponding function on the monitor, revealing that the signal for Lloyd's tracker was available again, Zane commented that reaching Primeval's Eye would not be easy.

Return to Primeval's Eye[]

Atop a nearby rooftop, Zane and the other four ninja carefully planned their move on the Ninjago City Impound Lot. After observing the two security guards, the five made their move to infiltrate and steal back their vehicles. While the other four were able to perform their jobs without issue, Zane was just about to enter the cockpit of his jet, but was spotted by the pair of guards and instinctively raised his hands over his head. To his surprise, Wu arrived and apologetically attacked the guards, herding them into the guard booth so they could not call for backup or interfere. Wu then admitted to Zane that he made a mistake by sitting out when the ninja broke the law last time to retrieve Aspheera's staff, and he would not make that mistake this time. In response, Zane exclaimed that it was good to see their master fighting alongside with them once more before activating his jet and speeding off to Primeval's Eye.

While Kai, Cole, and Jay established a perimeter around the jungle, Zane was ordered to take a more active role in rescuing Lloyd. In particular, Zane provided aerial support for the Destiny's Bounty against the Council of the Crystal King and their Dragonides, driving away Aspheera, Vangelis, and later Pythor. After clearing the skies of their enemies, Zane flew by the Destiny's Bounty and signaled to Wu that the skies were clear. He would then be ordered to retreat alongside the others as the Crystal Island appeared on the horizon.

Crystastrophe[]

With his jet, Zane provided aerial support for his beleaguered allies fighting on the grounds of the Farmers' village. He was then ordered by Kai to perform an attack run on the Crystal Island but was forced to break off his attack when the Island deployed three Dragonides to counter-attack. After flying for some time to evade the Dragonides, Zane made his way back to the temple once more and unleashed a barrage of missiles from his jet, reacting with shock when the missiles deflected harmlessly against the Island's surface. To add to matters, Zane's jet suddenly lost all power as it neared the Island, sending him plummeting to the ground below!

Fortunately, Zane was able to restore power to his jet just before impact with the ground and warily warned his allies about his experience when he approached the temple and how it seemly drained power from his jet. Zane would then continue to provide aerial support for the rest of the ninja until they collected a shard of crystal and retreated.

A Lesson in Anger[]

After returning to the Samurai X Cave, Zane and the other ninja gathered around as Wu told them about his discovery of the Oni form and its potential ability to defeat the Crystal army. When Garmadon revealed his presence, Zane and Kai immediately activated their elemental powers in anticipation of a confrontation. Zane also called out for Wu to get to safety, though Wu instead revealed that he was responsible for bringing Garmadon to the cave. Garmadon then explained he had changed since their last encounter and now strove to teach Lloyd the secrets of Oni form.

As Lloyd struggled to achieve Oni form, Zane and the others watched on with increasing discomfort as Garmadon began lambasting Lloyd for every perceived failure. When Garmadon insisted that the key to achieving Oni form was through embracing anger and channel it through one's face, Zane turned to Wu to ask his opinion of Garmadon's statement, emphasizing that it seemed contradictory to all of Wu's teachings. Tensions between the ninja and Garmadon would only further inflame later on when Garmadon blamed Wu's teachings for Lloyd's inability to achieve Oni form, greatly angering everyone present except Zane who instead urged for calm. Breaking up the fight, Zane reminded everyone that infighting would get them nowhere and would only serve to allow their enemies to gather their strength. Not long afterwards, P.I.X.A.L. revealed that she had made upgrades to the ninja's vehicles, thus enabling them to challenge the Crystal army head on. In response to this news, Zane and the other three original ninja rushed to their vehicles and sped off towards Ninjago City.

Brave But Foolish[]

Arriving in Ninjago City, Zane immediately piloted his jet to begin another attack run on the Crystal Island while the other three ninja fought the Crystal Warriors on the ground. Flying towards the island, Zane unleashed his jet's missiles and inflicted some, but still minor, damage to the floating structure. As he then circled around the island while considering the results of his initial attack run, Zane was attacked by a Dragonide, which tore off one of his jet's wings and caused him to begin plummeting to the ground.

As the jet, its pilot, and the Dragonide inched ever closer to the ground, the hulking crystal beast leapt off the jet with enough force that the jet slammed hard onto one of the city's highways. Still skidding against the road, Zane attempted to eject but failed, leaving him incapable of doing anything else other than closing his eyes as he braced for impact.

Return of the Ice Emperor[]

Heavily damaged from his crash, Zane's cloaking device went haywire and he began generating holographic cloaks of random people he had met in the past, all while offline the entire time. When P.I.X.A.L. found him, Zane's cloak alternated between Clutch Powers, Akita, Racer Seven, and Benthomaar just to name a few. Hoping to get him out, P.I.X.A.L. opened the jet's cockpit though Zane's body fell out in pieces as a result of the damages he had sustained. As P.I.X.A.L. began gathering up Zane's parts, his cloak switched into that of the Ice Emperor just as Zane returned offline and somehow reasserted his Ice Emperor persona.

As the Ice Emperor, Zane caused a lot of trouble for P.I.X.A.L. as she attempted to discreetly make her way to Borg Tower in hopes of repairing his body, nearly costing both of them their lives when Zane's shouting attracted the attention of a platoon of Vengestone Guards. Fortunately, the timely arrival of Ronin managed to save them - a gesture Zane declared he would honor by allowing Ronin to live, for now! Throughout the ride to Borg Tower, Zane would continue to spout nonsense as the Ice Emperor, at one point calling for Vex to throw his saviors into the dungeon despite clearly not being inside his former castle.

After arriving at Cyrus Borg's office, P.I.X.A.L. placed her backpack holding Zane's parts onto the former's desk and requested his aid in making repairs. When Borg stared at the Ice Emperor's face in confusion, wondering if he was looking at Zane, the Emperor shouted that there was no Zane!

Compatible[]

Cyrus Borg and P.I.X.A.L. worked together to rebuild Zane's shattered body. Although they were able to reassemble the Nindroid, they were unable to restore his mind after many hours of trying. Eventually, with time running short, P.I.X.A.L. knelt before Zane's inactive body and spoke her final goodbyes to him. Before she could leave however, Zane's lights suddenly flashed on and he called out to her as he rose from the table he rested on.

When Borg expressed his surprise and confusion over how Zane reactivated himself, Zane confessed that he did not know the answer, only that he heard P.I.X.A.L.'s voice, and somehow, that brought him back.

An Issue of Trust[]

Sometime after arriving outside the Newspaper warehouse, Zane and P.I.X.A.L. stepped outside to greet the rest of the ninja, during which he shared a hug with Lloyd. Zane and the others were then ushered inside by Wu who spoke to them about his discovery of Dragon Form. Zane and the others then attempted to perform the art, but were unsuccessful, and after many unsuccessful attempts, they discovered that its scroll was intended to be folded.

Wu read aloud the transcription found on the folded scroll and questioned the meaning of its riddle; Zane briefly chimed in to define "main" as meaning force or strength, but was interrupted by a call from Cyrus Borg, warning them that the Crystal army was approaching the warehouse. Although he noted that successfully defending against the Crystal army would be difficult, Zane nevertheless took position alongside the rest of the ninja outside the warehouse and prepared for the final battle. Once the battle was initiated, Zane and the others bravely charged ahead to confront the Crystal army.

Dragon Form[]

Zane fought hard against the approaching Crystal Warriors, but was forced to back away towards the newspaper warehouse as his foes drew ever closer. Zane and the others then watched with speechless expressions as their many allies gathered together to provide aid and smashed apart the ranks of the Crystal Warriors. The ninja then realized that this was the moment prophesized by Quanish, and with Wu's urging, Zane and the other three original members of the ninja once again attempted to unlock Dragon Form - successfully achieving the art.

With the pure powers of Ice at his command, Zane flew into several of the Crystal Warriors, shattering them immediately on impact. When Mister F gave chase to P.I.X.A.L. and her Ninja Ultra Combo Mech, Zane intercepted and knocked the evil nindroid from the back of his Dragonide! Zane then flew Mister F through a nearby billboard and dropped him down onto the rooftop before challenging his opponent for his Shuriken of Destruction. After swiftly dodging Mister F's first throw of the shuriken, Zane caught it but gasped in surprise as the weapon began to slowly crystallize him! Thinking quickly, Zane channeled his elemental power into the shuriken and much to his relief, this worked! As the Shuriken of Destruction was purified back into the Shuriken of Ice, an annoyed Mister F drew his katana and rushed at him. After trading a few blows, Zane turned to smash the billboard's damaged piling and dropped it onto Mister F, crushing the nindroid below as Zane passed through the hole he had made in its side, unharmed. With Mister F defeated, Zane briefly glanced towards the Crystal Island before rejoining the fight on the ground.

On the ground battle, Zane caught a glimpse of Cole wresting the Scythe of Destruction from Vangelis only to struggle as the weapon itself began to crystallize him as well. Knowing his friend's predicament, Zane flew over to Cole's side and called out for him to channel his elemental power of Earth into the weapon. Cole heeded Zane's instruction and did so, purifying the Scythe of Quakes and defeated Vangelis while Zane glanced towards a nearby rooftop where Kai fought Aspheera for the Sword of Destruction. Once victory on the ground was achieved, Zane regrouped with the other three ninja to celebrate their recovery of the Golden Weapons before flying down to celebrate, hugging P.I.X.A.L. and twirling her in midair. Zane then regrouped with Wu and the other ninja just as Aspheera slithered over to decry their victory. Before the Sorceress could proclaim again that she would have revenge, Zane blasted her with ice and froze her once again, much to Kai's relief. Unfortunately, victory would be cut short moments later, for the Crystal Island above them now crackled with energy as it began moving towards the center of the city. Zane and the others were then informed by Wu about the Overlord's intention to corrupt the Elements of Creation and that the battle had already been lost.

Roots[]

Wu informed Zane and the other ninja that they needed to unite the Golden Weapons, explaining that doing so would result in the Elemental Powers contained within them being released and returning to their original forms. He asserted that this was the only viable method to stop the Overlord, who had already succeeded in conquering Ninjago, from seizing the Elements of Creation to destroy the Balance. Zane agreed with Wu, recognizing that there were no alternative options available. The group then flew to the newspaper warehouse, where Kai asked if anyone had final words. Zane thanked them, stating that if they were to perish, he could not have wished for better friends, emphasizing their support for one another until the very end. On the count of three, Zane united the Shurikens of Ice with the other Golden Weapons, unleashing a powerful beam of energy. The Overlord retaliated, crystalizing all of Ninjago, turning its inhabitants, including Zane, into crystal zombies.

However, after a brief period, Zane and the others were purified, leaving them bewildered as they witnessed the Crystal Island explode. They celebrated their victory over the Overlord, though Nya and Wu questioned how they won. Soon after, Lloyd, Garmadon, and Harumi arrived with the Golden Ultra Dragon. Initially wary of Harumi's presence, Lloyd reassured Zane and the others of her allegiance. The ninja took a moment to admire the Golden Ultra Dragon, realizing it was the original form of the Elemental Powers Wu had mentioned. Zane gently petted the Ice Dragon's head, but he was taken aback when the dragon began to fade away. Wu explained that the elemental powers were returning to their source, indicating that Zane, Cole, Jay, and Kai had temporarily lost their Elemental Powers. Zane then approached P.I.X.A.L., taking her hands in his.

A week later, Zane took part in the reconstruction of the Monastery of Spinjitzu, observing that at their current rate, it would take more than 12 years to complete the task, which frustrated Kai. Just then, Dareth approached, announcing that he had brought the Resistance to assist with the efforts. Zane then joined the group in the rebuilding process, working alongside P.I.X.A.L as they carried a bathtub to the monastery.

Quest for the Lost Powers

Quest for the Lost Powers[]

Zane left the Monastery with P.I.X.A.L. to Nya's former Samurai X Cave to run a program P.I.X.A.L developed that might be able to help him regain his powers.

Believing that in order for Zane to regain his powers he needed to travel back to the memories of his long, eventful life, P.I.X.A.L told Zane that her program would immerse him in his memories as if he was actually there. Nobody in the memory would actually notice him and he strictly be an observer. He would be able to call on P.I.X.A.L to extract him anytime. P.I.X.A.L told him that she was also working on the program to work on biological brains.

Nervous about going back to a memory about his time as the Ice Emperor, Zane plugged himself in.

He first went into the memory of him overcoming his fear of the Titanium Dragon, back in Chen's dungeon, with the aid of P.I.X.A.L. The memory then blurred, transporting him to when he rode the Titanium Dragon, inspiring the other elemental masters to create their own elemental dragons and leave Chen's Island.

Coming back out of his memories, Zane told P.I.X.A.L that he concluded that while fear is what held him back then, it's not what's holding him back now.

Asking P.I.X.A.L to bring him to his early memories of meditating at the frozen lake, Zane swam to the bottom and meditated alongside his memory self.

His meditative state caused the memory program to be activated remotely, causing him to travel to the memory of Dr. Julien turning off his memory switch. Waiting for the memory to end, Zane instead found himself exploring his memories between his father's death and Master Wu meeting him for the first time.

Zane witnessed his younger self building a snowman, living in an igloo, and saving people from Treehorns. Zane remarked that despite his past self not having any memories, he was still Zane, liking the cold and protecting those who couldn't protect themselves.

Zane then travelled to a memory of his time as the Ice Emperor. Quickly asking P.I.X.A.L to extract him from this memory, Zane came back into the present.

He then had a conversation with her, noting that while he wasn't afraid of the Ice Emperor himself, Zane was afraid of seeing the horrible things that he did at the time, which was why he never thought about them.

P.I.X.A.L then convinced him to go back to face his past, and plugged him directly with an Ice Emperor memory.

In the memory, the Ice Emperor is informed of the arrival of the ninja in the Never-Realm by Vex, to which the emperor orders the destruction of them and all who help them.

Zane cried out angrily over the Emperor's cruel actions, in response to which, much to the shock of Zane, he heard and attempted to kill Zane. P.I.X.A.L informed him that a glitch with the program was occurring and that he was transported to his subconscious.

Despite his best efforts to take the Ice Emperor's staff, Zane's lower body became trapped in ice, during which Zane questioned him on why he was like this. The Emperor responded by saying that he was reprogrammed.

Transported to another memory, Zane saw Vex convincing his past self to take over the Never Realm, crying out in anger. The memory then shifted.

Zane landed in another Ice Emperor memory. Vex told the Emperor how a village refused to pay fish as tribute, and requested the village's destruction. While the Emperor initially hesitated, which Zane interpreted as him fighting the spell on the Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu. However, when Vex talked about a slippery slope that would end in his doom, the Ice Emperor ordered the destruction of the village. Zane yelled sadly and angrily at the same time at the Ice Emperor, but he couldn't hear him, being in a memory.

Going to another memory, Zane saw how Lloyd brought back his memories by mentioning how he was built to protect those who could not protect themselves, concluding that just like when he was younger, without his memories, he was still Zane, just overwhelmed and corrupted by the Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu.

Being transported back into his subconscious and stuck in ice again, Zane forgave the Ice Emperor for what he did. Zane then felt energy coursing through him, unlocking his elemental powers again.

Knocking the Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu from the Ice Emperor's hand, Zane saw himself return in the Emperor's body. Proclaiming that they were done, Zane woke back up in the Samurai X cave.

Creating an ice sculpture of her, Zane celebrated with P.I.X.A.L and proceeded to return to the Monastery with her.

Dragons Rising, Season 1

Dragons Rising, Season 1[]

Zane was outside the Monastery with the rest of the ninja when the Merge began. Zane and the others then boarded the Destiny's Bounty and set off towards Ninjago City, rescuing as many citizens as possible. During the Merge, Wu mouthed to himself that he thought he could "pull it off," but that "it happened too soon," Zane was with Lloyd and couldn't hear due to the raging loud storm and holding onto one of the rails.[7] After the Merge occurred, Zane was separated from the rest of the team and remained on standby for years in a stasis pod in the Monastery of Imperium.

The Calm Inside[]

Zane regained consciousness and exited the capsule, catching Kai and Nya off guard with his sudden appearance. Perplexed, Zane asked about his current location, recollecting the events of the Merge. Nya informed him that years have passed since that incident. While engaged in conversation, a control panel emitted a series of urgent beeps. Zane connected a cable to his head, receiving a distress signal. Zane initiated a sequence of actions, causing the Monastery of Imperium to emerge from beneath the ground. Accompanied by Kai and Nya, they make their way toward Imperium.

The Battle of the Second Monastery[]

Lloyd approached Zane, Kai, and Nya and questioned about how they had arrived at Imperium. Zane replied that he had no knowledge of it as he had just been activated. While observing the Photacs and Nya's failed attempt to defeat one, Zane tried to freeze it but was unsuccessful. Lloyd aided him in avoiding being pushed back by Rapton. Lloyd then asked about the temple, and Zane explained that it was the Monastery of Imperium, similar to the Monastery of Spinjitzu. During the battle, Zane created an ice wall to protect the ninja, Wyldfyre, and the dragons, indicating that they should retreat. When Lloyd asked where they should go, Zane suggested the Monastery of Imperium, whose fortified walls could temporarily keep the Photacs out.

Retreating into the Monastery, Nya closed the gate behind them as Lloyd addressed the ninja. He warned them that the dragons should not be caught in the battle against the Photacs. Nya suggested using the portal gate to return to Ninjago, but Zane explained that it while the gate is connected to the one at the Monastery of Spinjitzu, it could not handle the transfer of all the dragons, as increasing the gate's capacity would require an immense amount of energy. Nya proposed searching for energy sources, and Zane revealed that there was a colossal energy source beneath Imperium. Intrigued, Lloyd activated a mechanism to descend into the tunnels, where he and Zane discovered a massive energy sphere. Zane clarified that the sphere itself was not the source, but rather the creature within it. Lloyd mentioned that it was a dragon, and Zane pointed out the dragon before them was the largest he had ever seen so far. Lloyd made a firm commitment to liberate the dragon, despite Zane's uncertainty about how they could accomplish it and where they would find the necessary power source to free all the dragons from Imperium. As they approached the sphere, they discovered that the dragon was communicating with them telepathically. As Zane was surprised, Lloyd explained to him that some dragons possessed that ability. The dragon warned them about the consequences. Freeing it would potentially destabilize the merged lands and lead to catastrophic destruction.

Zane and Lloyd both sense the determination of the Source Dragon to remain captive. Without a power source, they were unable to rescue the other dragons from Imperium. The Source Dragon, recognizing Lloyd as an Elemental Master, mentioned that he has contained dragon power in the past. The Source Dragon revealed his identity and explained that his kind possess enough dragon power to destroy a realm. However, due to his imprisonment, he was unable to do so. Lloyd realized that he can become the conduit for the Source Dragon's power, just as he did with the Matriarch Dragon. This would enable him to activate the portal and free the other dragons. Despite the potential risks, Lloyd was willing to take the chance. Lloyd activated the portal gate, enabling the dragons to escape to Ninjago. However, the immense power he absorbed left him drained and fatigued, requiring Zane to provide support by catching him. Once Sora successfully deactivated the Photacs, Zane and the rest of the group seized the opportunity to pass through the portal and make their escape. Upon returning to the Monastery, Zane recounted the events to the other ninja, ensuring they were informed. A few days later, as Lloyd regained consciousness, Zane and the others returned from the new dragon stables to greet him.

The Temple of the Dragon Cores[]

This section is a stub. You can help expand this section by adding some information.


Gangs of the Sea[]

The ninja come together to split into groups to retrieve the Dragon Cores: Lloyd and Arin to the Mother Garden, Nya, Sora, and Riyu to the Pinnacle of Crystals, and Kai and Wyldfyre to the Wyldness while Zane stayed behind so he could attempt to find Jay, Cole, or even P.I.X.A.L. As the ninja leave, Zane retorts to himself about how he'll work peacefully, only to get wiped on by monastery's first Assistant Keeper, Alfonzo Frohicky.

Wyldly Inappropriate[]

As Zane attempted to activate the gate, Mr. Frohicky showed up with some tea for him, but the former declined, due to it being invested with flies. When the tracker's wyconium coil shorted out, Zane and Mr. Frohicky went to the junkyard at the Crossroads with Zane wearing a fake moustache along with his old trench coat and fedora so that he wouldn't be recognized as the ninja were still declared missing.

When they arrive however, a mech racer named Kreel had claimed ownership of the junkyard after winning the deed in a lice game, which Zane thought she mistook it for dice. Asking about the wyconium coil, Kreel refused to hand it over when Zane and Mr. Frohicky admit they have no money, resulting in the two being thrown out. Attempting to find work to get the money, they head into town where a festival called Zane Day was on, where the goers seemingly act like Zane. Hearing about a look-a-like contest, Zane himself entered under the name 'Blane' and did a bad impersonation, inadvertently harmed the host with his powers when fellow contestant Lobbo threw some ice at him by accident, and ran out of time trying to rearrange a toaster, all leading to him coming dead last. However, Gulch, who was one of the judges, gave Zane a gift certificate to Kreel's Junkyard as consultation, but failed to recognize the latter.

The Last Djinn[]

This section is a stub. You can help expand this section by adding some information.


Prior to The Administraion[]

Zane attempted to activate the portal gate, which gained the attention of Administration Agents, Roderick Allen and SsssSsss Underwood, who detain him, and take him to the Administration, where the one of the managers, put him to work, sorting out mail pending his sentence. Overtime, Zane learned about the Administrator, the leader of the Administration.

The Administration[]

When Lloyd and Arin showed up while trying to find the Pink Dragon Core, Zane provided them with fake Administration forms with crude drawings of the two and messages to guide them to him, thinking they were coming to rescue him, until told otherwise. Learning that the core was scheduled to be incinerated, they use the chute to reach the demolition level. However, Allen and Underwood, who were on Lloyd and Arin's trail upon discovering the fake forms, diverted their paths with Zane ending up in the vehicle bay level, full of confiscated vehicles before taking a racing car and met up with Lloyd, who stole a mech, and make their exit as Arin was able to rejoin them. Needing a punch card, Zane heads to the cubicle responsible, only to learn he needs to fill out the paperwork, which he swiftly completed and took the card, using it to return to the Mother Garden.

Recovering the Bounty, the three ninja return to the monastery, where Kai and Wyldfyre told them the Purple Dragon Core was taken by Dorama, a pyrotechnician hired by Beatrix. Leaving their core behind, all five ninja return to Imperium, where a shockwave knocks them all down.

Absolute Power[]

Needing a way in, Kai has Wyldfyre attract some guards so that they could take their hoverboards, which worked. In the city, they were ambushed by the guards, only for the Imperium Teen Resistance Force to show up and knock them all out before they beckon the ninja to accompany them.

We Are All Dragons[]

This section is a stub. You can help expand this section by adding some information.


The Power Within[]

As Beatrix began creating MergeQuake rifts, refusing to listen to the ninja as they try to reason with her, they attempt to fight her, only for Beatrix to send Kai, Wyldfyre, and Riyu into separate rifts before Sora, achieving her True Potential, dismantles the weapon and Arin kicks Beatrix into a rift.

With the rifts now creating a MergeQuake Storm, the ninja head to the Crossroads, briefly delayed when the Bounty loses its sails, until Zanth grows big, attaches herself to the hull, and flies fast. Upon reaching the Crossroads, Zane saves two Greenbone Warriors and Grab-Barg before the ninja unite once Mr. Frohicky brought the last core to them, which Lloyd then used to thwart the storm and stabilize the Merged Realms, also leaving their presence known to the public again.

The following morning, Nya explains to Zane how Cole felt the earth around him and learns that Wu called to the latter before they soon went to have some of Arin's Snowberry Pies.

Dragons Rising, Season 2

Dragons Rising, Season 2[]

The Blood Moon[]

NinjaFanInfinity and SpinjitzuForDays99 film Zane, who was with Lloyd, Kai, and Nya as they were checking up on Lobbo, whose mech was out of control before the latter moved to join Arin, Sora, Wyldfyre, Riyu, and some citizens, who were having a party when Lobbo's mech was turned into a DJ set by Sora.

Zane and Kai returned to the Monastery of Spinjitzu, playing Lava Zombies and having a conversation in Arin and Sora's room. Later, when Lloyd approached them, Zane observed that Lloyd seemed fatigued and mentioned that his body's vital functions were showing signs of exhaustion. Zane then inquired if Lloyd was experiencing any trouble sleeping.

Shattered Dreams[]

Zane gathers in a meeting with the ninja over last night where Lloyd's visions of the wolf warriors were true. Zane heads with Lloyd, Sora, and Arin to the Crossroads where they meet with the shop owner Fedulian. Although Fedulian doesn't tell them what the mallet Cinder stole was and spying on him they go to ask his associate Hantro who tells them that it was the Mallet of Shattering. When an injured Euphrasia arrives and tells them that Ras conquered the Cloud Kingdom with the wolf warriors, Zane goes with the rest where they learned of Ras' plan to release the Forbidden Five using the Ritual of the Blood Moon and witness Cinder using Shatterspin.

Beyond the Phantasm Cave[]

As the ninja decided to leave the Monastery of Spinjitzu to find Dragon Masters that they need to find to defeat Ras and his army. Hoverer despite other ninja, Zane decided to stay in Monastery in case any emergencies arise.

The Spell at the Waterfall[]

Zane approached Alfonzo Frohicky with a series of questions. Alfonzo initially believed that Zane was inquiring about the doll he had given him, and proceeded to explain his reasoning behind the gift. However, Zane corrected him, clarifying that he was actually referring to the portal gate. Zane urged Alfonzo not to block the gate, but Alfonzo initially refused, citing Zane's argument that the gate was not functioning properly due to its connection to Imperium. Nevertheless, Zane persisted and informed Alfonzo that the portal gate had mysteriously materialized as a result of the Merge's mystical energies, and could activate at any moment. Alfonzo eventually accepted Zane's words and ceased blocking the gate. However, just as Alfonzo was descending the ladder, the portal gate suddenly activated, and Cole and the Finders emerged from the Land of Lost Things into Ninjago. In the chaos, Alfonzo was inadvertently thrown from the ladder to the ground. Cole and the Finders immediately sought Zane's assistance, prompting the Ice Ninja to inquire about the nature of the problem. Upon the arrival of two Wolf Mask Claw Warriors, Zane quickly deduced the reason behind Cole and the Finders' plea for help, and agreed to assist Cole. Zane and Cole joined forces to combat the Wolf Mask Claw Warriors, while the Finders and Alfonzo took cover to avoid harm. Together, Zane and Cole successfully defeated the warriors and sent them back to the Land of Lost Things. Zane then revealed to Cole that Ras was leading the Wolf Clan, which greatly surprised Cole. Zane went on to explain that Ras had taken control of the Cloud Kingdom, which explained why the wolf warriors were attacking from there. Zane was confused as to why Ras wanted Bonzle, but upon learning that Bonzle was not a person but a spell, he requested that Bonzle recount her previous life's story.

Following Bonzle's acceptance, she proceeded to narrate the tale of her origin, recounting her pivotal role in aiding the Dragon Masters in banishing the Forbidden Five to the Nether-Space. As she delved into her narrative, detailing her centuries-long journey through various realms, Zane was taken aback to learn that she had encountered Wu. Surprised by this revelation, Zane mentioned that Wu had never disclosed this information to him. However, Bonzle emphasized that while it may not have been significant to Wu, it held immense importance for her. Upon the conclusion of Bonzle's recounting of her life, Zane finally comprehended why Ras had shown interest in Bonzle. Zane sought additional information by asking about Mysterium, the birthplace of Bonzle. Bonzle clarified that Mysterium is a mystical realm and one of the former Sixteen Realms, but like the rest, merged with the other realms to form the Merged Lands. Zane agreed to join Cole on his quest to find Bonzle's creator at Mysterium, remarking that it reminded him of the adventures from the past.

To Mysterium[]

Zane, Cole and Bonzle went to Jiro to get to Mysterium although they didn't have any accurate maps of the Merged lands. They decided to go to the Crossroads where Bonzle and Cole decide to check out All-Realm Antiques Emporium, which was owned by Fedulian. Zane advise not to go in because of Fedulian's record of being untrustworthy and due to seeing Zane before. Although Fedulian notices them Zane puts on a mustache so Fedulian dosen't recognize him and he gives them a map of the Merged Lands.

As they fly to Mysterium, they discover the map is not accurate as they're coming across a poisonous cloud, which forces them to land with Jiro injured from the poison. As they land Zane discovers the markings on the map had disappeared, realizing Fedulian gave them a fake map and should of trusted his memory banks before eventually continuing forward, only to encounter Dorama who had made a deal with Fedulian to hand out fake maps to algae farmers to make them his students at Dorama's Academy for Acting. Zane and Cole manage to defeat Dorama and Zane manage to create a map to Mysterium thanks to Dorama's Imperium tech, which Dorama had scanned the local terrain, creating a wealth of regional maps.

Inside the Maze[]

Zane was in the Temple City quarters when Lloyd told everyone it was time to go to the game plaza. However since Roby refused to tell who everyone is competing against until the event itself annoyed the Ninja.

Zane gathered with the ninja when they agreed to only use Rising Dragon to counter Shatterspin. Zane was first announced where he fought against Zur. Zane manage to freeze Zur's leg but the ice melted fast and Zane was knock out of the match. After Zane lost his powers to Zur, he reassured Lloyd that using excessive force is not the ninja way, despite their mission. When Nya was called up Zane was surprise to see her opponent was Jay. Shock at seeing his friend on Ras' team and treat Nya like a stranger, Zane was left completely speechless, until Lloyd reminded him that none of them knows what happened to Jay after he disappeared in the Merge. Zane watch Jay attack Nya and even used a Wolf Mask to shatter his goodness. After the match, despite Nya winning, Zane found the victory to be bittersweet as they lost Jay to evil.

United We Fall[]

Zane reminded her that if their world was destroyed, there would be no Jay to save Lloyd assured Nya that they would find Jay after the tournament.

The next morning, Zane found Lloyd watching Nya train alone in the Games Plaza. As she broke a piece of wood in half, a shard flew through the air, nearly hitting Zane—only for Lloyd to catch it just in time. Zane joined Lloyd to help Sora cope with her anxieties of her opponents.

The Sword Shatters[]

Zane woke up, ready for training. Later, as the group walk back to their quarters Cole shared with him the strange visit he'd experienced the previous night—a mysterious monastery revealed to him by the yellow orb. He wondered aloud why the orb had chosen him to see it. Zane suggested that instead of dwelling on why he was guided to the monastery, Cole should focus on how to get there.

As they entered their quarters, they found Arin deep in thought, working through a puzzle of his own. Zane was surprised to see that Ras had allowed both Arin and Riyu to leave, especially considering their past with him. He noted that their history with Ras might have created a bias, clouding their judgment and blinding them to other possible threats. The conversation shifted to the list of potential suspects, but then Arin brought up something else; a mysterious symbol he had discovered. Cole immediately suggested he visit the Temple City Museum, knowing it housed a vast collection of ancient art and writing that might offer clues. As Arin left, Cole's attention shifted to his behavior around Sora. Zane remarked that his social algorithm had detected unusually high levels of cringe.

Elements of Betrayal[]

Zane and Arin rushed towards the Monastery of Gates, with the latter voicing his exasperation over Lloyd's skepticism regarding Master Wu's involvement in the Merge. Zane attempted to calm him, acknowledging the weight of the revelation, yet Arin remained adamant that the repercussions were severe, as Wu's actions had not only resulted in the disappearance of his parents but also endangered the Merged Lands. Upon their arrival, they found Cole grappling with the Crowns of Horns, which were stubbornly affixed to the ceiling. Zane informed him that the tournament was nearing its conclusion, but Arin stressed the urgency of their mission, warning that if Ras were to succeed, he would swiftly utilize the horns to gain access to the Source Dragons. Suddenly, a resounding crash reverberated through the monastery's walls as Cole, using his mech, punched through to create an opening. To their astonishment, Nya and Riyu emerged from the newly formed breach. Zane expressed his surprise at their unexpected appearance, prompting Nya to explain that she had found a method to communicate with Kai through Dragon Ivory, a discovery that could aid in rescuing him and Bonzle, albeit with the potential danger of unleashing the Forbidden Five. When Zane asked further about her findings, Nya revealed that she and Riyu had learned about this just before being captured by Nokt and Jordana. Just then, Nokt and Jordana arrived, prompting Zane and the other ninja to prepare for a confrontation. However, they soon discovered that Nokt and Jordana had no interest in Ras's ambitions. As Nokt and Jordana used Shatterspin, Zane and Nya countered with Rising Dragon technique. Nokt pressed forward towards the Monastery of Gates with the intent to liberate the remaining members of the Forbidden Five, while Jordana faced off against Zane, Cole, and Nya, intending to employ Theroxian Magic. To their astonishment, they noticed Jordana exhibiting unusual behavior, soon realizing that she had been possessed by Rox since the Ritual of the Blood Moon. In her struggle against Rox, Zane and Nya attempted to fight her, but Rox retaliated by casting a static spell that immobilized Zane, Cole, and Nya. As Rox mocked the trapped ninja, her taunts were abruptly interrupted when Nokt successfully freed the Forbidden Five, resulting in Rox's soul being forcibly extracted from Jordana. With a warning about the plans of the Forbidden Five, Jordana managed to release Zane and the others from their paralysis. Lloyd, Sora, and Wyldfyre regrouped with Zane and the others, and together, they made their way to the Monastery of Gates, determined to prevent the Forbidden Five from escaping.

Zane and the others reluctantly allied with Ras in their battle with Nokt, who unleashed a barrage of Elemental Powers against them. In the midst of the chaos, Nokt wielded Ras' golden hammer to send Zane, Arin, and Riyu sprawling. He then used Shatterspin, causing the Elemental Earth Mech to collide violently with a pillar, nearly crushing Zane, who was saved by Cole. Meanwhile, Nya, drawing upon dragon energy from Riyu, directed the energy towards the Crowns of Horns, liberating Kai and Bonzle. A confrontation ensued between Kai and Nokt, where Kai initially gained the advantage but ultimately succumbed to Nokt. Zane, Nya, and Riyu attempted to intervene, only to be repelled by Nokt's use of Energy. However, Roby and Wyldfyre arrived, with Roby using the Elemental Cup to reclaim the stolen Elemental Powers from Nokt, restoring Zane's Ice powers in the process.

Cornered, Nokt managed to escape with the remaining members of the Forbidden Five through a portal gate to the Cloud Kingdom, taking Ras hostage. Arin pursued them, but upon his arrival, the Forbidden Five destroyed the gate to evade capture, resulting in an explosion that transported everyone who had approached the gate to an different Merged Land. Upon reuniting, Zane, Cole, Wyldfyre, and Riyu welcomed Kai back with open arms. The group then made their way to the Games Plaza, where they participated in a victory ceremony, during which Roby officially proclaimed Sora as the Champion of the Sources. Following the celebration, Zane and the other ninja returned to the Monastery of Spinjitzu via a portal gate. Cole then shared troubling news with Zane, revealing that the Writers of Destiny had not find Arin, as no one had emerged from their side of the portal gate. This revelation filled Zane with dread, leading him to confront the realization that Arin was now stranded in a distant land.

The Missing[]

Zane was conducting various calculations on where the portal gate explosion sent Arin, but he didn't get any results. He came in when Frak and Sora were arguing about her pies, which Sora pointed out Zane likes her pies, with Zane agreeing but also pointed out he lacks taste buds and doesn't taste them. After seeing Sora's latest pie blow up Zane realized he was only calculating the possible trajectories and didn't account for the not possible ones. inputting the data, he manage to get a location on Arin's location.

Zane and the others arrive where their coordinates said Arin might of been but ended up fighting Dorama's puppet which was brought to life thanks to a Prismatic Blade Frak found and pull out of the puppet's head.

The Ultimate Object of Admiration[]

Zane, Riyu, Frak, Sora, and Lloyd flew on Zanth where they decided to split up due to Zanth being unable to fit in a cave. Zane decide to take her down the mountain to search in that direction while the other ninja search the cave. While Lloyd didn't like the idea of Zane going alone, Zane says that he has Zanth.

The Great Zane Robbery[]

Zane and Zanth continued to search down the mountain in the First Land where Zane was unable to scan for any life-forms being organic or otherwise. As two moved on to the next valley, Zane notices Zanth dancing with a nearby bird where Zane remarks that he experience that behavior like that is considered weird. Zane jumped on Zanth and they flew off where Zane notices another Monastery.

Landing in the Monastery, Zane notes the Monastery is similar to the one they have yet strangely different. Zane theorizes that since each realm gained it's own Monastery during The Merge is true then this must be this land's monastery. Going inside Zane hears voices and realized it is Rapton and the Freebooters who were stealing a techno-cocoon from the Monastery. Zane interrupts Rapton as he was threatening one of his members, saying the stuff they stolen from the monastery doesn't belong to them but Rapton fights Zane off while the other take the cocoon with them, which Zane recognizes as they leave.

Once Zane breaks down the door, he chases after their prison train but Zanth comes and gets him closer to their train. Scanning the train, Zane located the cocoon and once inside, Zane remarks the Kreel will be jealous as the train is more of a junkyard than her place and notices the Freebooters have been more successful at looting than Zane though. Zane noticed the cocoon and finds a way to open the cocoon which reveals Zane's long-lost girlfriend P.I.X.A.L. comes back online, much to his joy.

Zane hugs P.I.X.A.L., who is confused because they saw each other this morning but Zane tells her that it has been years since the Merge, which was apparently orchestrated by Master Wu and recent strange events had happened as a result. Zane also tells P.I.X.A.L. that the ninja also gained new members like Arin, Sora, Riyu, and Wyldfyre. Although Rapton interrupts their moment which Zane and P.I.X.A.L. fight him and the Freebooters off before getting out. However as the two got out Zane recognizes Nokt and several unknown warriors break into the train. Zane and P.I.X.A.L. go back into the train where they saw the Red Prismatic Blade, Nokt was after and Zane recognizes from an episode earlier. Zane manage to fight off Nokt but the Dragonian warriors knock the blade out of his hand where P.I.X.A.L. catches it and heads out of the train. Nokt activates Shatterspin which knocks Zane back and escapes. Nokt also causes the train to crash which Zane override the train controls by plugging himself in and manages to stop the train but it left him in a catastrophic state.

I Alone Can Save Them[]

P.I.X.A.L. held Zane as he continued to malfunction with his "Primary... electronics disrupted... secondary elements" but P.I.X.A.L. told him to save his energy, as she gathered pieces from the prison train. Despite Rapton's reluctance, P.I.X.A.L. convinced him to help repair Zane.

P.I.X.A.L. manages to repair Zane, also giving him a bigger body where they rescue Lloyd, Sora, Frak, and Riyu from Zarkt. When Frak first saw P.I.X.A.L. he thought he changed but Lloyd revealed she is P.I.X.A.L. and then Zane appeared in his larger form, fighting off the Dragonian Warriors with Sora commenting Zane had a glow up. After Zarkt retreats, Zane informs Lloyd that the Five are gathering special blades for an unidentified nefarious purpose. Lloyd told Zane that he knows and shows him the Blue Prismatic Blade where it is like this but sounds the same as the sword from Lloyd's fight with Zeatrix. After analyzing the blade, Zane says it is made of the same kind of rare metal as Zeatrix's sword was.

Fallen Wishes[]

Zane was with Lloyd when he wondered what the Blue Prismatic Blade was. Although Sora had poofed away but reappeared later and informed Zane and the other the use of the Prismatic Blades.
